entries.shortAnswer: 「软装」的英文是 soft furnishing，指可移动的家具、窗帘、灯具、装饰品等。它常与硬装相对，搬家时通常能带走。
entries.definition: soft furnishing 多用于英式英语，美式常说 soft furnishings 或 home decor；指窗帘、地毯、靠垫、灯具、摆件等可更换的装饰性布置，与吊顶、防水、水电改造等硬装相对。

examples.en: We finished the hard renovation first, then spent a month choosing soft furnishing for the living room.
examples.zh: 我们先完成硬装，然后花了一个月为客厅挑选软装。

examples.en: Good soft furnishing can make a small apartment feel warm and cozy without changing the walls.
examples.zh: 好的软装不用改动墙体，就能让小户型显得温馨舒适。

entries.shortAnswer: soft furnishing 的中文意思是「软装」，指可移动、可更换的室内装饰布置。它强调家具、窗帘、地毯、灯具等陈设，与硬装结构施工相对。
entries.definition: soft furnishing 通常作不可数名词，英式英语常用；指窗帘、靠垫、地毯、灯饰等可更换的室内装饰。注意与硬装区分：soft furnishing 不涉及承重墙、防水、水电改造。

examples.en: We finished the hard renovation first, then spent a month choosing soft furnishing for the living room.
examples.zh: 我们先完成硬装，然后花了一个月为客厅挑选软装。

examples.en: Good soft furnishing can make a small apartment feel warm and cozy without changing the walls.
examples.zh: 好的软装不用改动墙体，就能让小户型显得温馨舒适。

entries.shortAnswer: 承重墙的英文是 load-bearing wall，指支撑上部楼层重量的墙体，注意连字符不能省略。
entries.definition: 装修中承重墙不可拆改或开洞，否则危及结构安全。常见搭配：remove a load-bearing wall。非承重墙叫 partition wall。

examples.en: Before renovating, you must check which walls are load-bearing walls, because removing one can compromise the entire structure.
examples.zh: 装修前必须检查哪些墙是承重墙，因为拆除承重墙会危及整个建筑结构。

examples.en: The contractor refused to knock down that load-bearing wall without a structural engineer's approval.
examples.zh: 承包商拒绝在没有结构工程师批准的情况下拆除那面承重墙。

entries.shortAnswer: load-bearing wall 的中文意思是承重墙，指支撑建筑物上部重量的墙体，不能随意拆除。
entries.definition: load-bearing wall 是建筑装修术语，指承受并传递荷载的墙体。口语也说 bearing wall，勿与 retaining wall 混淆。

examples.en: Before renovating, you must check which walls are load-bearing walls, because removing one can compromise the entire structure.
examples.zh: 装修前必须检查哪些墙是承重墙，因为拆除承重墙会危及整个建筑结构。

examples.en: The contractor refused to knock down that load-bearing wall without a structural engineer's approval.
examples.zh: 承包商拒绝在没有结构工程师批准的情况下拆除那面承重墙。

entries.shortAnswer: 「硬装」的英文是 structural renovation，指水电、墙面、地面、吊顶等固定的基础工程，与软装相对。
entries.definition: 硬装指与建筑结构一体的固定部分，如水电、墙面、地面、吊顶等；英文常说 structural renovation，不要直译为 hard decoration。

examples.en: Before moving in, we did a full structural renovation, including rewiring, waterproofing, and a new ceiling.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我们做了完整的硬装，包括重新布线、防水和新吊顶。

examples.en: The structural renovation took three months because we had to reinforce a load-bearing wall and redo the floor.
examples.zh: 硬装花了三个月，因为我们必须加固一面承重墙并重做地面。

entries.shortAnswer: 「硬装」的英文是 structural renovation，指水电、墙面、地面、吊顶等不可移动的基础工程。
entries.definition: 硬装即 structural renovation，指对承重结构、水电、防水、墙面地面等基础部分的改造，常见搭配 do a structural renovation。

examples.en: Before moving in, we did a full structural renovation, including rewiring, waterproofing, and a new ceiling.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我们做了完整的硬装，包括重新布线、防水和新吊顶。

examples.en: The structural renovation took three months because we had to reinforce a load-bearing wall and redo the floor.
examples.zh: 硬装花了三个月，因为我们必须加固一面承重墙并重做地面。

entries.shortAnswer: 户型用英语说是 floor plan，但请注意：floor plan 通常指房屋的平面布局图，而 unit type 常指开发商提供的户型类型，如两室一厅。
entries.definition: floor plan 侧重房屋内部空间划分和尺寸的平面图；描述户型时常用 a two-bedroom floor plan 表示两室户型。看房时问 What's the floor plan? 即问户型布局。

examples.en: Could you send me the floor plan so I can see how the rooms are arranged?
examples.zh: 你能把户型图发给我吗？我想看看房间是怎么布局的。

examples.en: This apartment has a practical floor plan with a bay window and plenty of storage space.
examples.zh: 这套公寓户型很实用，带一个飘窗和充足的收纳空间。

entries.shortAnswer: floor plan 的中文意思是户型（图）。它指房屋平面布局图，强调房间位置和面积；而 layout 可泛指任何布局。
entries.definition: floor plan 指建筑平面图或户型图，常见搭配：draw/design a floor plan, open floor plan（开放式户型）。口语中也可指户型本身。

examples.en: Could you send me the floor plan so I can see how the rooms are arranged?
examples.zh: 你能把户型图发给我吗？我想看看房间是怎么布局的。

examples.en: This apartment has a practical floor plan with a bay window and plenty of storage space.
examples.zh: 这套公寓户型很实用，带一个飘窗和充足的收纳空间。

entries.shortAnswer: 「水电改造」的英文是 plumbing and rewiring，指装修时重新铺设水管和电线，属装修家居常用词。
entries.definition: 常用搭配 do plumbing and rewiring；勿直译 water and electricity modification。plumb 指水管，rewire 指重新布线。

examples.en: The apartment was handed over as a bare shell, so we had to do all the plumbing and rewiring before moving in.
examples.zh: 这套公寓是毛坯房交房，所以我们入住前必须做全部的水电改造。

examples.en: A full plumbing and rewiring job can cost a fortune, especially if you need to chase the walls.
examples.zh: 全面的水电改造可能花费不菲，尤其是需要在墙上开槽的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: Plumbing and rewiring 的中文意思是「水电改造」，即装修中重新铺设水管和电线的工程。
entries.definition: 英式常用 plumbing and rewiring，美式也说 plumbing and electrical work；多指翻新旧房线路。

examples.en: The apartment was handed over as a bare shell, so we had to do all the plumbing and rewiring before moving in.
examples.zh: 这套公寓是毛坯房交房，所以我们入住前必须做全部的水电改造。

examples.en: A full plumbing and rewiring job can cost a fortune, especially if you need to chase the walls.
examples.zh: 全面的水电改造可能花费不菲，尤其是需要在墙上开槽的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: 「量房」的英文是 measure the room，指装修前测量房间尺寸，注意与 measure the wall 区分。此表达侧重整个房间的空间测量。
entries.definition: 量房是装修第一步，常见搭配：measure the room for renovation、measure the room dimensions。易错点：不要用 measure the house，那听起来像测整栋房子外部。

examples.en: Before buying any furniture, we need to measure the room to make sure everything fits.
examples.zh: 买任何家具之前，我们需要先量房，确保所有东西都放得下。

examples.en: The designer came to measure the room and noted the positions of the windows and power outlets.
examples.zh: 设计师来量房，并记录了窗户和电源插座的位置。

entries.shortAnswer: measure the room 对应中文「量房」，指测量房间尺寸以备装修，比 measure the house 更具体，通常指室内单个房间的测量。
entries.definition: measure the room 用于装修、家居布置，核心义是测量房间长宽高、门窗及电源位置。口语也可说 measure up the room。

examples.en: Before buying any furniture, we need to measure the room to make sure everything fits.
examples.zh: 买任何家具之前，我们需要先量房，确保所有东西都放得下。

examples.en: The designer came to measure the room and noted the positions of the windows and power outlets.
examples.zh: 设计师来量房，并记录了窗户和电源插座的位置。

entries.shortAnswer: 铺瓷砖的英文是 lay tiles。注意：lay tiles 是“铺”，不是“贴”，贴瓷砖常用 stick tiles；lay 的过去式和过去分词是 laid。
entries.definition: lay tiles 强调把瓷砖铺设到地面或墙面，常见搭配有 lay tiles on the floor/wall。装修中铺瓷砖前需做防水 waterproofing，并注意瓷砖留缝和找平。

examples.en: We need to lay tiles in the bathroom after the waterproofing is done.
examples.zh: 防水做完后，我们需要在浴室铺瓷砖。

examples.en: He laid tiles in the entryway to make it easier to clean.
examples.zh: 他在玄关铺了瓷砖，这样更容易清洁。

entries.shortAnswer: lay tiles 的中文意思是铺瓷砖。它指把瓷砖铺设到表面，常与 floor 或 wall 搭配；与 stick tiles 不同，lay 强调铺设动作而非粘贴。
entries.definition: lay tiles 是动词短语，指铺设瓷砖，常用于装修语境。搭配如 lay tiles on the floor/wall。过去式 laid tiles。注意 lay 是及物动词，宾语是瓷砖，不是位置。

examples.en: We need to lay tiles in the bathroom after the waterproofing is done.
examples.zh: 防水做完后，我们需要在浴室铺瓷砖。

examples.en: He laid tiles in the entryway to make it easier to clean.
examples.zh: 他在玄关铺了瓷砖，这样更容易清洁。

entries.shortAnswer: 「刷漆」的英文是 paint the walls，但注意它特指给墙壁上漆，若泛指刷漆需根据宾语调整，比如 paint the door。
entries.definition: paint the walls 强调给墙壁刷漆，是装修中的常见表达。若说“刷漆”作为职业或动作，也可用 painting；但具体到墙面时，paint the walls 最自然。注意 paint 既可指油漆也可指绘画，语境决定词义。

examples.en: We need to paint the walls before moving in, and the landlord suggested a light gray color.
examples.zh: 我们搬进去之前需要刷漆，房东建议用浅灰色。

examples.en: After fixing the waterproofing, they decided to paint the walls themselves to save money.
examples.zh: 做完防水后，他们决定自己刷漆以节省开支。

entries.shortAnswer: 「paint the walls」的中文意思是「刷漆」，特指给墙壁涂刷油漆，与泛指刷漆的 paint 不同，后者需根据宾语判断。
entries.definition: paint the walls 是动词短语，意为给墙壁刷漆，常用于家居装修语境。paint 可作名词（油漆）或动词（涂刷），但 walls 明确了动作对象。口语中也可说 do some painting 表示刷漆工作。

examples.en: We need to paint the walls before moving in, and the landlord suggested a light gray color.
examples.zh: 我们搬进去之前需要刷漆，房东建议用浅灰色。

examples.en: After fixing the waterproofing, they decided to paint the walls themselves to save money.
examples.zh: 做完防水后，他们决定自己刷漆以节省开支。

entries.shortAnswer: 「防水」在装修中常指 waterproofing，也就是做防水层或防水处理，避免渗漏。
entries.definition: waterproofing 指防水层、防水处理或防水工程，如 do waterproofing、waterproofing membrane。形容词 waterproof 指材料本身防水，勿混用。

examples.en: We need to finish the waterproofing in the bathroom before tiling.
examples.zh: 我们需要在贴瓷砖前完成卫生间的防水。

examples.en: Good waterproofing keeps the basement dry in humid weather.
examples.zh: 良好的防水能让地下室在潮湿天气里保持干燥。

entries.shortAnswer: waterproofing 的中文意思是「防水」，指装修中的防水层施工或防水处理，用于防渗漏。
entries.definition: waterproofing 作名词，指防水处理、防水层或防水材料，如 do waterproofing、waterproofing membrane；形容词 waterproof 指防水的。

examples.en: We need to finish the waterproofing in the bathroom before tiling.
examples.zh: 我们需要在贴瓷砖前完成卫生间的防水。

examples.en: Good waterproofing keeps the basement dry in humid weather.
examples.zh: 良好的防水能让地下室在潮湿天气里保持干燥。

entries.shortAnswer: 「吊顶」英文是 suspended ceiling，指悬吊在楼板下的顶部装饰层，不是泛指天花板的 ceiling。
entries.definition: suspended ceiling 常搭配 install / put up a suspended ceiling，美式口语也说 drop ceiling。吊顶用于藏管线、装筒灯或做造型，施工前要确认水电与检修口。

examples.en: The contractor installed a suspended ceiling to hide the ductwork and recessed lights.
examples.zh: 承包商装了吊顶，用来遮住风管和嵌入式灯具。

examples.en: Before installing a suspended ceiling, make sure the waterproofing and wiring are finished.
examples.zh: 装吊顶之前，要确认防水和水电改造已经完成。

entries.shortAnswer: Suspended ceiling 就是中文「吊顶」，指用龙骨吊杆悬吊在楼板下的二次顶部构造，与普通 ceiling 不同。
entries.definition: suspended ceiling 是装修建筑常用词，美式口语常说 drop ceiling，指格栅加矿棉板的办公吊顶；家装造型吊顶常叫 false ceiling。

examples.en: The contractor installed a suspended ceiling to hide the ductwork and recessed lights.
examples.zh: 承包商装了吊顶，用来遮住风管和嵌入式灯具。

examples.en: Before installing a suspended ceiling, make sure the waterproofing and wiring are finished.
examples.zh: 装吊顶之前，要确认防水和水电改造已经完成。

entries.shortAnswer: 飘窗的英文是 bay window，指凸出外墙的窗户。注意 bay window 是建筑术语，不是指“飘浮的窗户”。
entries.definition: bay window 指凸出建筑外墙的窗户，通常形成窗台或休息区。装修中常涉及承重墙、防水、台面材质等，如“飘窗改书桌”需注意结构安全。

examples.en: The living room has a large bay window that lets in plenty of natural light.
examples.zh: 客厅有一个大飘窗，采光很好。

examples.en: We turned the bay window into a cozy reading nook with cushions and shelves.
examples.zh: 我们把飘窗改造成了带靠垫和架子的舒适阅读角。

entries.shortAnswer: Bay window 的中文意思是“飘窗”，一种凸出外墙的窗户。与普通窗户不同，它常带窗台，可作休息或收纳区。
entries.definition: Bay window 指凸出外墙的窗户，常见于客厅或卧室，可增加采光和空间感。装修时需考虑承重、防水和台面材料，口语中也可说 window seat。

examples.en: The living room has a large bay window that lets in plenty of natural light.
examples.zh: 客厅有一个大飘窗，采光很好。

examples.en: We turned the bay window into a cozy reading nook with cushions and shelves.
examples.zh: 我们把飘窗改造成了带靠垫和架子的舒适阅读角。

entries.shortAnswer: 玄关的英文是 entryway，指进门处的过渡空间；口语也常说 entry 或 hallway，但别用 porch（门廊）。
entries.definition: entryway 指住宅入口内侧的过渡区，常放鞋柜、换鞋凳与挂衣钩；英式英语多用 hall 或 entrance hall。

examples.en: We put a shoe cabinet and a bench in the entryway.
examples.zh: 我们在玄关放了一个鞋柜和一条换鞋凳。

examples.en: The entryway is small, so storage and organizing matter a lot.
examples.zh: 玄关很小，所以收纳整理非常重要。

entries.shortAnswer: entryway 的中文意思是玄关，即进门后的过渡空间；它与 entry 基本同义，但更强调这块区域本身。
entries.definition: entryway 指住宅入口内侧的小块过渡区域，常用于放鞋、挂衣与收纳；英式英语更常说 hall 或 entrance hall。

examples.en: We put a shoe cabinet and a bench in the entryway.
examples.zh: 我们在玄关放了一个鞋柜和一条换鞋凳。

examples.en: The entryway is small, so storage and organizing matter a lot.
examples.zh: 玄关很小，所以收纳整理非常重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 全屋定制的英文是 custom cabinetry，指按户型量身定制全屋柜体。注意它侧重柜类，不是全屋整装，欧美更常见成品或半定制。
entries.definition: 全屋定制常用 custom cabinetry，也可说 custom built-in furniture。中国行情按投影或展开面积报价，并看板材环保等级如 E0、ENF；欧美多为成品或 semi-custom，这是关键差异。

examples.en: We chose custom cabinetry for the entryway and kitchen to make the most of every inch.
examples.zh: 我们为玄关和厨房选择了全屋定制，以充分利用每一寸空间。

examples.en: Custom cabinetry often costs more than semi-custom, but it fits bay windows and odd corners perfectly.
examples.zh: 全屋定制通常比半定制贵，但它能完美贴合飘窗和异形角落。

entries.shortAnswer: Custom cabinetry 的中文意思是全屋定制，指按户型量身定做全屋柜体。它与普通成品柜不同，强调尺寸贴合和一体化设计。
entries.definition: Custom cabinetry 指量身定制的柜体系统，常见搭配有 kitchen cabinetry、built-in cabinetry。它不等于全屋整装，在欧美多用于厨房、衣帽间等局部，而非全屋所有木作。

examples.en: We chose custom cabinetry for the entryway and kitchen to make the most of every inch.
examples.zh: 我们为玄关和厨房选择了全屋定制，以充分利用每一寸空间。

examples.en: Custom cabinetry often costs more than semi-custom, but it fits bay windows and odd corners perfectly.
examples.zh: 全屋定制通常比半定制贵，但它能完美贴合飘窗和异形角落。

entries.shortAnswer: 「地板」的英文是 flooring，指铺设地面的材料总称。注意 flooring 是材料，不是具体某块地板；具体一块地板叫 floorboard 或 tile。
entries.definition: flooring 统称地板材料，如木地板 wood flooring、瓷砖地板 tile flooring。装修语境常说 install flooring（铺地板），不指家具或地毯。与 floor 不同，floor 指地面本身或楼层。

examples.en: We chose waterproof vinyl flooring for the bathroom because it's easy to clean.
examples.zh: 我们为浴室选了防水的乙烯基地板，因为它容易清洁。

examples.en: The contractor said the hardwood flooring needs to acclimate for a few days before installation.
examples.zh: 承包商说实木地板在安装前需要适应环境几天。

entries.shortAnswer: flooring 的中文意思是「地板」，指铺设地面所用的材料。它强调材料类别，不指单块地板；单块地板是 floorboard 或 tile，而 floor 指地面本身。
entries.definition: flooring 是名词，指地板材料，常见搭配有 wood flooring、tile flooring、vinyl flooring。多用于装修、建材语境，较正式；口语也可说 put in flooring。注意与 floor（地面）和 carpet（地毯）区分。

examples.en: We chose waterproof vinyl flooring for the bathroom because it's easy to clean.
examples.zh: 我们为浴室选了防水的乙烯基地板，因为它容易清洁。

examples.en: The contractor said the hardwood flooring needs to acclimate for a few days before installation.
examples.zh: 承包商说实木地板在安装前需要适应环境几天。

entries.shortAnswer: 踢脚线在美式英语中叫 baseboard，英式英语常说 skirting board，别与顶角线混淆。
entries.definition: baseboard 指墙脚与地板交接处的装饰板，常见搭配有木质踢脚线、安装踢脚线和踢脚线取暖器。美式用 baseboard，英式多用 skirting board。

examples.en: The carpenter installed a white baseboard along the wall to cover the gap between the floor and the wall.
examples.zh: 木匠沿着墙壁安装了白色踢脚线，用来遮盖地板和墙壁之间的缝隙。

examples.en: In British English, baseboard is usually called skirting board, but both refer to the same trim at the bottom of a wall.
examples.zh: 在英式英语中，踢脚线通常被称为墙裙板，但两者都指墙脚底部的装饰板。

entries.shortAnswer: baseboard 的中文意思是踢脚线，指墙脚与地板交接处的装饰板；英式英语常用 skirting board。
entries.definition: baseboard 是美式英语，指墙脚与地板交接处的装饰板，常见搭配有木质踢脚线、安装踢脚线和踢脚线取暖器。英式英语用 skirting board。

examples.en: The carpenter installed a white baseboard along the wall to cover the gap between the floor and the wall.
examples.zh: 木匠沿着墙壁安装了白色踢脚线，用来遮盖地板和墙壁之间的缝隙。

examples.en: In British English, baseboard is usually called skirting board, but both refer to the same trim at the bottom of a wall.
examples.zh: 在英式英语中，踢脚线通常被称为墙裙板，但两者都指墙脚底部的装饰板。

entries.shortAnswer: 「阳台」的英文是 balcony，指建筑物外挑或凹进的有栏杆平台。注意 balcony 通常指住宅的阳台，而 terrace 多指屋顶大平台或露台，不能混用。
entries.definition: Balcony 常与 enjoy the view、dry clothes 搭配，如 sit on the balcony。装修时需注意防水和承重，封闭阳台用 enclosed balcony。

examples.en: We often have breakfast on the balcony when the weather is nice.
examples.zh: 天气好的时候，我们经常在阳台上吃早餐。

examples.en: She decorated her balcony with potted plants and a small chair.
examples.zh: 她用盆栽和小椅子装饰了阳台。

entries.shortAnswer: Balcony 的中文意思是「阳台」，即建筑物外带栏杆的平台。和 terrace 不同，balcony 通常从墙面外挑，而 terrace 多为屋顶或地面上的大平台。
entries.definition: Balcony 是可数名词，常见搭配有 on the balcony、balcony door。指住宅外挑的有栏杆平台，也指剧院楼座；而 terrace 指屋顶或地面的大露台。

examples.en: We often have breakfast on the balcony when the weather is nice.
examples.zh: 天气好的时候，我们经常在阳台上吃早餐。

examples.en: She decorated her balcony with potted plants and a small chair.
examples.zh: 她用盆栽和小椅子装饰了阳台。

entries.shortAnswer: 「散味」的英文是 air out the smell，指装修后通风去除甲醛和异味；注意 air out the smell 强调通过空气流通让气味消散，而非用香薰掩盖。
entries.definition: 散味是中国新房入住前的仪式性环节，动辄通风数月。英文常用 air out the house 或 let it off-gas，off-gassing 是建材释放挥发性有机物的专业说法。

examples.en: After the renovation, we left the windows open for three months to air out the smell of paint and glue.
examples.zh: 装修后，我们开窗通风三个月，散散油漆和胶水的味道。

examples.en: New furniture can off-gas for weeks, so you should air out the smell before moving into the room.
examples.zh: 新家具会持续释放气体好几周，所以搬进房间前应该先散味。

entries.shortAnswer: 「air out the smell」的中文意思是「散味」，特指装修后开窗通风让甲醛等异味自然消散；与 air freshener 不同，它强调通风置换而非掩盖气味。
entries.definition: air out the smell 用于描述通过通风去除室内异味，常见搭配 air out the house/room。口语中也可说 let it off-gas，off-gassing 指建材持续释放气体，多用于装修环保语境。

examples.en: After the renovation, we left the windows open for three months to air out the smell of paint and glue.
examples.zh: 装修后，我们开窗通风三个月，散散油漆和胶水的味道。

examples.en: New furniture can off-gas for weeks, so you should air out the smell before moving into the room.
examples.zh: 新家具会持续释放气体好几周，所以搬进房间前应该先散味。

entries.shortAnswer: 甲醛的英文是 formaldehyde，指室内装修中常见的有害气体。注意不要与防腐用的 formalin（福尔马林）混淆。
entries.definition: 甲醛是室内空气污染的头号指标，常见搭配：甲醛检测（formaldehyde testing）、除甲醛（formaldehyde removal）、E0/E1 级板材（E0/E1 grade boards）。散味即通风释放甲醛。

examples.en: New cabinets often release formaldehyde, so you should ventilate the room for weeks.
examples.zh: 新橱柜通常会释放甲醛，所以房间需要通风几周。

examples.en: They chose E0-grade plywood to reduce formaldehyde emissions in the nursery.
examples.zh: 他们选用 E0 级胶合板以降低儿童房的甲醛释放量。

entries.shortAnswer: Formaldehyde 的中文意思是甲醛，一种用于建材和胶黏剂的刺激性气体。它是装修污染的核心指标，区别于防腐液 formalin。
entries.definition: Formaldehyde 常出现在装修语境中，如 formaldehyde emissions（甲醛释放）、formaldehyde-free（无醛）。口语也说 off-gassing。注意：formalin 是甲醛水溶液，不是气体本身。

examples.en: New cabinets often release formaldehyde, so you should ventilate the room for weeks.
examples.zh: 新橱柜通常会释放甲醛，所以房间需要通风几周。

examples.en: They chose E0-grade plywood to reduce formaldehyde emissions in the nursery.
examples.zh: 他们选用 E0 级胶合板以降低儿童房的甲醛释放量。

entries.shortAnswer: 窗帘的英文是 curtains，日常几乎都用复数形式；单扇帘子才说 a curtain，别漏掉 s。
entries.definition: curtains 指挂在窗户上的布帘，常见搭配有 draw the curtains（拉上窗帘）、open the curtains（拉开窗帘）。装修语境中还常说 blackout curtains（遮光帘）、bay window curtains（飘窗窗帘）。

examples.en: We hung blackout curtains in the bedroom so the morning sun wouldn't wake us up.
examples.zh: 我们在卧室装了遮光窗帘，这样早晨的阳光就不会把我们弄醒。

examples.en: Draw the curtains before you start the movie—the glare on the TV is terrible.
examples.zh: 放电影前把窗帘拉上，电视屏幕上的反光太厉害了。

entries.shortAnswer: curtains 的中文意思是窗帘，也可指舞台幕布；表示家中窗帘时通常用复数，单说 a curtain 多指一块帘布。
entries.definition: curtains 作复数指成对的窗帘，常见搭配 draw/close the curtains（拉上）、open the curtains（拉开）、blackout curtains（遮光帘）。口语中也说 curtains 表示完蛋了，属引申义，与家居义无关。

examples.en: We hung blackout curtains in the bedroom so the morning sun wouldn't wake us up.
examples.zh: 我们在卧室装了遮光窗帘，这样早晨的阳光就不会把我们弄醒。

examples.en: Draw the curtains before you start the movie—the glare on the TV is terrible.
examples.zh: 放电影前把窗帘拉上，电视屏幕上的反光太厉害了。

entries.shortAnswer: 灯饰的英文是 light fixtures，指固定安装在天花板或墙壁上的照明装置。注意与可移动的 lamp（台灯、落地灯）区别，灯具是装修硬装的一部分。
entries.definition: light fixtures 常用复数形式，涵盖吊灯、吸顶灯、壁灯等固定照明设备。装修语境中常与安装、布线搭配，如 install light fixtures。口语中也说 light fittings，但美式英语更常用 light fixtures。

examples.en: The interior designer suggested installing pendant light fixtures above the kitchen island.
examples.zh: 室内设计师建议在厨房岛台上方安装吊灯。

examples.en: Before moving in, we need to replace all the old light fixtures in the hallway.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我们需要更换走廊里所有旧灯饰。

entries.shortAnswer: Light fixtures 的中文意思是灯饰，特指固定安装的照明装置。与可移动的 lamp（台灯、落地灯）不同，它属于装修硬装部分。
entries.definition: Light fixtures 指固定在天花板或墙上的照明设备，如吊灯、吸顶灯、壁灯。装修或电工语境常用，搭配 install、replace、hang 等动词。注意与 lamp（可移动灯具）和 light bulb（灯泡）区分。

examples.en: The interior designer suggested installing pendant light fixtures above the kitchen island.
examples.zh: 室内设计师建议在厨房岛台上方安装吊灯。

examples.en: Before moving in, we need to replace all the old light fixtures in the hallway.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我们需要更换走廊里所有旧灯饰。

entries.shortAnswer: 床垫的英文是 mattress，指铺在床上供人躺卧的软垫，注意它只指垫子本身，不含床架。
entries.definition: mattress 是可数名词，指床垫本体，常见搭配有 spring mattress（弹簧床垫）、memory foam mattress（记忆棉床垫）、firm mattress（硬床垫）。

examples.en: We need a new mattress because this one is too soft and old.
examples.zh: 我们需要一张新床垫，因为这张太软又太旧了。

examples.en: She chose a firm mattress to help with her back pain.
examples.zh: 她选了一张硬床垫来缓解背痛。

entries.shortAnswer: mattress 的中文意思是床垫，即铺在床架上供人睡觉的厚软垫，与 cushion（靠垫）不同，专指床上的大垫子。
entries.definition: mattress 是可数名词，指床垫。常见搭配：spring mattress（弹簧床垫）、memory foam mattress（记忆棉床垫）、a firm mattress（硬床垫）。

examples.en: We need a new mattress because this one is too soft and old.
examples.zh: 我们需要一张新床垫，因为这张太软又太旧了。

examples.en: She chose a firm mattress to help with her back pain.
examples.zh: 她选了一张硬床垫来缓解背痛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「家具」的英文是 furniture，不可数名词，统指桌椅床柜等可移动陈设，不能加 s。
entries.definition: furniture 是总称，表示家具时不用复数，计数需借助 a piece of furniture 或 an item of furniture，常见搭配有 office furniture、garden furniture。

examples.en: We bought all our furniture from a local store when we moved into the new apartment.
examples.zh: 搬进新公寓时，我们所有的家具都是从当地一家商店买的。

examples.en: The living room looks spacious because there is very little furniture in it.
examples.zh: 客厅看起来很宽敞，因为里面家具很少。

entries.shortAnswer: Furniture 的中文意思是「家具」，指桌椅床柜等可移动的居家物品，它是不可数名词，没有复数形式。
entries.definition: Furniture 是集合名词，涵盖桌椅床柜等可移动的家具，常见搭配有 a piece of furniture、office furniture、patio furniture。

examples.en: We bought all our furniture from a local store when we moved into the new apartment.
examples.zh: 搬进新公寓时，我们所有的家具都是从当地一家商店买的。

examples.en: The living room looks spacious because there is very little furniture in it.
examples.zh: 客厅看起来很宽敞，因为里面家具很少。

entries.shortAnswer: 「邻居噪音」的英文是 noisy neighbors，指隔壁或楼上楼下住户传来的吵闹声。注意 noisy 是形容词，neighbors 用复数，不能写成 noisy neighbor noise。
entries.definition: noisy neighbors 是固定搭配，强调「吵闹的邻居」这一主体；若只想说噪音本身，可用 noise from neighbors 或 neighbor noise。口语常抱怨：My noisy neighbors keep me up at night.

examples.en: My noisy neighbors were drilling into the load-bearing wall again last night, so I could not sleep at all.
examples.zh: 我那吵闹的邻居昨晚又在承重墙上打孔，我根本睡不着。

examples.en: She complained to the property manager about the noisy neighbors upstairs, whose kids stomp around until midnight.
examples.zh: 她向物业投诉楼上吵闹的邻居，那家的孩子一直蹦到半夜。

entries.shortAnswer: noisy neighbors 的中文意思是「邻居噪音」，也可理解为「吵闹的邻居」。它指来自隔壁或楼上楼下、影响生活的持续噪声，而非偶发的一次响动。
entries.definition: noisy neighbors 为名词短语，指让人困扰的邻居住户或其产生的噪音。英式拼写 neighbour。常搭配 complain about、upstairs；比 loud 更含贬义，指令人烦躁、反复发生的嘈杂。

examples.en: My noisy neighbors were drilling into the load-bearing wall again last night, so I could not sleep at all.
examples.zh: 我那吵闹的邻居昨晚又在承重墙上打孔，我根本睡不着。

examples.en: She complained to the property manager about the noisy neighbors upstairs, whose kids stomp around until midnight.
examples.zh: 她向物业投诉楼上吵闹的邻居，那家的孩子一直蹦到半夜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「收纳」的英文是 storage and organizing，指整理并存放物品。
entries.definition: 装修家居中指用柜体、隔板等归类存放物品。注意 storage 只指存放空间，organizing 只指整理动作，二者常连用。

examples.en: We installed custom cabinets and shelves for better storage and organizing in the entryway.
examples.zh: 我们在玄关安装了定制柜和搁板，以便更好地收纳。

examples.en: Good storage and organizing makes a small apartment feel much bigger.
examples.zh: 良好的收纳能让小公寓显得宽敞很多。

entries.shortAnswer: Storage and organizing is the English for 收纳, meaning arranging and keeping items.
entries.definition: In home improvement, it means using cabinets and boxes to keep things tidy. Storage alone is just space; organizing alone is just arranging.

examples.en: We installed custom cabinets and shelves for better storage and organizing in the entryway.
examples.zh: 我们在玄关安装了定制柜和搁板，以便更好地收纳。

examples.en: Good storage and organizing makes a small apartment feel much bigger.
examples.zh: 良好的收纳能让小公寓显得宽敞很多。

entries.shortAnswer: 智能家居的英文是 smart home，指通过物联网技术联动控制家电、照明与安防的住宅系统。注意别直译成 intelligent house，那听起来像一栋聪明房子。
entries.definition: smart home 为可数名词，常说 build a smart home、smart home devices、smart home system。口语里也讲 smart home setup，指整套智能家居方案，装修时通常与水电改造同步规划。

examples.en: We are turning our new apartment into a smart home with smart lights, a smart lock and voice control.
examples.zh: 我们正把新公寓改造成智能家居，装上智能灯、智能门锁和语音控制。

examples.en: Before installing a smart home system, make sure every room has enough network ports and power outlets.
examples.zh: 安装智能家居系统之前，要确保每个房间都有足够的网口和电源插座。

entries.shortAnswer: smart home 的中文意思是智能家居，指用网络把灯光、空调、安防等设备连起来统一控制的住宅。它强调设备互联，而 home automation 更侧重自动控制这个动作本身。
entries.definition: smart home 是英语常用复合名词，可数，常见搭配有 smart home devices、smart home system、set up a smart home。正式场合和技术文章都通用，口语里也可泛指带智能设备的家。

examples.en: We are turning our new apartment into a smart home with smart lights, a smart lock and voice control.
examples.zh: 我们正把新公寓改造成智能家居，装上智能灯、智能门锁和语音控制。

examples.en: Before installing a smart home system, make sure every room has enough network ports and power outlets.
examples.zh: 安装智能家居系统之前，要确保每个房间都有足够的网口和电源插座。

entries.shortAnswer: 「装修队」的英文是 renovation crew，指负责房屋翻新现场施工的团队。
entries.definition: renovation crew 指装修施工团队，常见搭配有 hire a renovation crew。注意与设计师区分，装修队侧重现场施工。

examples.en: The renovation crew tore down the load-bearing wall without permission, which caused a serious safety hazard.
examples.zh: 装修队未经允许拆除了承重墙，造成了严重的安全隐患。

examples.en: We hired a renovation crew to waterproof the bathroom and install a suspended ceiling in the entryway.
examples.zh: 我们雇了一个装修队给卫生间做防水，并在玄关安装吊顶。

entries.shortAnswer: Renovation crew 的中文是「装修队」，指专门负责房屋翻新施工的团队。
entries.definition: renovation crew 指装修施工队，也可说 renovation team。常见搭配：hire a renovation crew。注意它指现场工人，不负责设计。

examples.en: The renovation crew tore down the load-bearing wall without permission, which caused a serious safety hazard.
examples.zh: 装修队未经允许拆除了承重墙，造成了严重的安全隐患。

examples.en: We hired a renovation crew to waterproof the bathroom and install a suspended ceiling in the entryway.
examples.zh: 我们雇了一个装修队给卫生间做防水，并在玄关安装吊顶。

entries.shortAnswer: 中医的英文是 traditional Chinese medicine，缩写 TCM，指中国传统医学体系；“看中医”常说 see a TCM doctor。
entries.definition: traditional Chinese medicine 指以阴阳五行、气血经络为理论的中国传统医学。缩写 TCM 常见于英文医学文献，可指中医师或中医诊所。

examples.en: More and more people in the West are turning to traditional Chinese medicine for chronic pain.
examples.zh: 越来越多西方人转向中医来治疗慢性疼痛。

examples.en: Her doctor of traditional Chinese medicine checked her pulse and said she had too much dampness.
examples.zh: 她的中医师给她把了脉，说她是体内湿气重。

entries.shortAnswer: traditional Chinese medicine 的中文是“中医”，缩写 TCM，指中国传统医学体系；也常指中医师。
entries.definition: traditional Chinese medicine 指中国传统医学体系，常见搭配 practice traditional Chinese medicine、doctor of traditional Chinese medicine。

examples.en: More and more people in the West are turning to traditional Chinese medicine for chronic pain.
examples.zh: 越来越多西方人转向中医来治疗慢性疼痛。

examples.en: Her doctor of traditional Chinese medicine checked her pulse and said she had too much dampness.
examples.zh: 她的中医师给她把了脉，说她是体内湿气重。

entries.shortAnswer: 「把脉」英文说 feel the pulse，是中医师用手指按病人手腕桡动脉来诊断的方法；注意它指中医辨证，不是西医单纯测心率。
entries.definition: 把脉是中医「望闻问切」四诊中的「切」，医生用三指按寸、关、尺三部，体察脉象以判断气血与脏腑状况；英文常用 feel the pulse 或 take the pulse，但后者多指测脉搏次数，目的与中医辨证不同。

examples.en: The doctor asked me to sit down and then felt the pulse on my wrist to check my health.
examples.zh: 医生让我坐下，然后按我手腕上的脉来检查身体状况。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, the practitioner may feel the pulse at three positions on each wrist to understand the body's condition.
examples.zh: 在中医里，医师会在每只手腕的三个位置把脉，以了解身体的状况。

entries.shortAnswer: Feel the pulse 的中文意思是「把脉」，指中医师用手指按手腕动脉来诊断病情；它与西医单纯测脉搏次数不同。
entries.definition: feel the pulse 在中医语境指「把脉、切脉」，医生按腕部桡动脉体察脉象，属望闻问切四诊之一；日常英文也可说 take the pulse，但多指测心跳快慢，不涉及辨证。

examples.en: The doctor asked me to sit down and then felt the pulse on my wrist to check my health.
examples.zh: 医生让我坐下，然后按我手腕上的脉来检查身体状况。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, the practitioner may feel the pulse at three positions on each wrist to understand the body's condition.
examples.zh: 在中医里，医师会在每只手腕的三个位置把脉，以了解身体的状况。

entries.shortAnswer: 「艾灸」的英文是 moxibustion，指用点燃的艾条或艾柱温灼穴位。艾灸与针灸 acupuncture 常并称，但 moxibustion 偏重热力与药性，不是针刺。
entries.definition: moxibustion 是中医外治法，英文也作 moxa treatment，动词短语常用 perform moxibustion。注意它和 acupuncture 不同：acupuncture 用针，moxibustion 用艾草燃烧的热力。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, moxibustion is often used to warm the meridians and dispel cold.
examples.zh: 在中医里，艾灸常被用来温通经络、驱散寒邪。

examples.en: She had moxibustion on her lower back to relieve the pain caused by dampness.
examples.zh: 她在腰背部做了艾灸，以缓解湿气引起的疼痛。

entries.shortAnswer: moxibustion 的中文意思是「艾灸」，一种用燃烧的艾草温灼穴位的中医疗法。它和 acupuncture（针灸）常一起出现，但 moxibustion 靠热力与药性，不靠针。
entries.definition: moxibustion 多用于中医、替代医学和养生语境，常见搭配有 moxibustion therapy、indirect moxibustion。正式场合可说 moxibustion treatment，口语里也有人直接说 moxa。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, moxibustion is often used to warm the meridians and dispel cold.
examples.zh: 在中医里，艾灸常被用来温通经络、驱散寒邪。

examples.en: She had moxibustion on her lower back to relieve the pain caused by dampness.
examples.zh: 她在腰背部做了艾灸，以缓解湿气引起的疼痛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「针灸」的英文是 acupuncture，指用细针刺激穴位的中医疗法，通常不可数。
entries.definition: acupuncture 为英文借词，医学语境直接使用，不加 the，常见搭配有 acupuncture treatment、acupuncture points。

examples.en: My doctor recommended acupuncture to help with my chronic lower back pain.
examples.zh: 我的医生建议用针灸来缓解我慢性的下背痛。

examples.en: She has acupuncture sessions every week to improve her sleep.
examples.zh: 她每周都做针灸治疗来改善睡眠。

entries.shortAnswer: Acupuncture means 针灸 in Chinese: a TCM therapy using thin needles on specific points.
entries.definition: Acupuncture is an uncountable noun for 针灸. Say acupuncture treatment or have acupuncture; no article or plural -s.

examples.en: My doctor recommended acupuncture to help with my chronic lower back pain.
examples.zh: 我的医生建议用针灸来缓解我慢性的下背痛。

examples.en: She has acupuncture sessions every week to improve her sleep.
examples.zh: 她每周都做针灸治疗来改善睡眠。

entries.shortAnswer: 推拿的英文是 tuina massage，也可直接说 tuina。在中医语境下强调手法治疗时，用 tuina massage 比普通 massage 更准确。
entries.definition: tuina massage 是中医外治法之一，通过按、揉、推、拿等手法作用于经络穴位，常译作 tuina 或 tuina massage，不可简单等同于普通放松按摩。

examples.en: After sitting at a desk for years, he tried tuina massage to relieve his chronic neck pain.
examples.zh: 多年伏案工作后，他尝试推拿来缓解长期的颈部疼痛。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, tuina massage is often used alongside acupuncture to promote the flow of qi and blood.
examples.zh: 在中医里，推拿常与针灸配合使用，以促进气血运行。

entries.shortAnswer: Tuina massage 的中文意思是推拿，是一种中医手法治疗。它与普通 massage 不同，强调经络穴位和调理气血。
entries.definition: Tuina massage 指中医推拿疗法，常见搭配有 traditional tuina massage、tuina therapy，属正式/专业用词；口语中也可单说 tuina，注意别与一般按摩混淆。

examples.en: After sitting at a desk for years, he tried tuina massage to relieve his chronic neck pain.
examples.zh: 多年伏案工作后，他尝试推拿来缓解长期的颈部疼痛。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, tuina massage is often used alongside acupuncture to promote the flow of qi and blood.
examples.zh: 在中医里，推拿常与针灸配合使用，以促进气血运行。

entries.shortAnswer: 「二手家具」英文是 secondhand furniture，指别人用过再出售的家具，注意连写。
entries.definition: secondhand 作形容词连写，修饰 furniture，如 buy/sell secondhand furniture、a secondhand furniture store。

examples.en: We furnished our apartment with secondhand furniture to save money and reduce waste.
examples.zh: 我们用二手家具布置公寓，既省钱又减少浪费。

examples.en: She found a secondhand furniture store that sells restored mid-century pieces.
examples.zh: 她找到一家二手家具店，专门出售翻新的中世纪风格家具。

entries.shortAnswer: Secondhand furniture 的中文是「二手家具」，即别人用过再出售的家具，与 used furniture 近义。
entries.definition: Secondhand furniture 指非全新、经他人转手的家具，常用于省钱、环保或复古装修语境。

examples.en: We furnished our apartment with secondhand furniture to save money and reduce waste.
examples.zh: 我们用二手家具布置公寓，既省钱又减少浪费。

examples.en: She found a secondhand furniture store that sells restored mid-century pieces.
examples.zh: 她找到一家二手家具店，专门出售翻新的中世纪风格家具。

entries.shortAnswer: 「上火」的英文常译为 internal heat，指中医里热性证候，如口疮、咽痛、长痘。日常可说 I have internal heat，正式要加 per TCM。
entries.definition: 上火不是感染或炎症，而是中医解释框架里的热象；英文没有完全对应的生理概念，常说 excessive internal heat per TCM，或用 inflammation、infection 向西方人解释。

examples.en: Eating too much spicy food can cause internal heat, which in traditional Chinese medicine explains mouth sores and sore throats.
examples.zh: 吃太多辛辣食物会引起上火，中医用它来解释口疮和咽痛。

examples.en: She said her acne was due to excessive internal heat and drank herbal tea to cool it down.
examples.zh: 她说自己的痘痘是上火引起的，于是喝凉茶来降火。

entries.shortAnswer: Internal heat 的中文是「上火」，是中医热性证候的口语说法，常见表现有口疮、咽痛、长痘。它不等于西医的感染或炎症。
entries.definition: Internal heat 多用于中医语境，指体内热象；日常可说 too much internal heat，正式则说 excessive internal heat per TCM。西方读者易误解为 inflammation 或 infection，需说明这是中医解释框架。

examples.en: Eating too much spicy food can cause internal heat, which in traditional Chinese medicine explains mouth sores and sore throats.
examples.zh: 吃太多辛辣食物会引起上火，中医用它来解释口疮和咽痛。

examples.en: She said her acne was due to excessive internal heat and drank herbal tea to cool it down.
examples.zh: 她说自己的痘痘是上火引起的，于是喝凉茶来降火。

entries.shortAnswer: 「中药」的英文是 Chinese herbal medicine，也可说 traditional Chinese medicine，后者涵盖针灸等。
entries.definition: 指以植物、动物、矿物为原料、按中医理论配伍使用的药物。常用搭配：take Chinese herbal medicine。

examples.en: My grandmother drinks a bowl of Chinese herbal medicine every morning to strengthen her immune system.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天早上喝一碗中药来增强免疫力。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed Chinese herbal medicine for her chronic cough after the usual drugs failed.
examples.zh: 常用药无效后，医生为她的慢性咳嗽开了中药。

entries.shortAnswer: Chinese herbal medicine 就是「中药」，指按中医理论配伍使用的天然药物，TCM 则范围更广。
entries.definition: Drugs made from plants, animals or minerals and used according to TCM theory. Uncountable: take Chinese herbal medicine.

examples.en: My grandmother drinks a bowl of Chinese herbal medicine every morning to strengthen her immune system.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天早上喝一碗中药来增强免疫力。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed Chinese herbal medicine for her chronic cough after the usual drugs failed.
examples.zh: 常用药无效后，医生为她的慢性咳嗽开了中药。

entries.shortAnswer: 「刮痧」英文是 gua sha scraping，媒体也常直接借用 gua sha。出痧是正常反应，不是受伤。
entries.definition: 常搭配 have gua sha scraping、do gua sha。刮拭体表出痧以驱邪排湿，正式介绍可加 per TCM。别把出痧误译 injury。

examples.en: After sitting in damp air-conditioning all week, she went for gua sha scraping to relieve her stiff neck and heavy body.
examples.zh: 在潮湿的空调环境里坐了一周后，她去做刮痧，缓解脖子僵硬和身体沉重。

examples.en: The red sha marks on his back look alarming, but his therapist explained they are a normal part of gua sha scraping, not bruising from injury.
examples.zh: 他背上的红色痧痕看起来吓人，但理疗师解释说这是刮痧的正常现象，不是受伤造成的淤青。

entries.shortAnswer: Gua sha scraping 中文是「刮痧」，用工具刮皮肤至出痧。美容圈的 gua sha facial 则是面部用法。
entries.definition: Gua sha scraping is a TCM therapy: a tool is pressed along skin until sha marks appear; they are not injuries.

examples.en: After sitting in damp air-conditioning all week, she went for gua sha scraping to relieve her stiff neck and heavy body.
examples.zh: 在潮湿的空调环境里坐了一周后，她去做刮痧，缓解脖子僵硬和身体沉重。

examples.en: The red sha marks on his back look alarming, but his therapist explained they are a normal part of gua sha scraping, not bruising from injury.
examples.zh: 他背上的红色痧痕看起来吓人，但理疗师解释说这是刮痧的正常现象，不是受伤造成的淤青。

entries.shortAnswer: 「湿气重」的英文可以说 excess dampness。这个词属于中医概念，不是单指天气潮湿；在英文里通常要补一句 in TCM 才清楚。
entries.definition: 中医常说「湿气重」，指体内水湿运化不畅，常见表现有身体困重、舌苔厚腻、大便黏滞、水肿感等。英文多写 excess dampness (in TCM)，有时也说 dampness retention；不要直接混用 humid 或 damp，那通常只是在说环境潮湿。

examples.en: My acupuncturist said my fatigue and heavy limbs might be due to excess dampness in TCM, so she suggested avoiding cold and greasy foods.
examples.zh: 我的针灸师说，我乏力、四肢沉重可能是中医里的湿气重，所以建议我少吃生冷和油腻食物。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, a thick greasy tongue coating is often seen as a sign of excess dampness.
examples.zh: 在中医里，舌苔厚腻常被视为湿气重的一个表现。

entries.shortAnswer: Excess dampness 的中文意思是「湿气重」。它主要出现在中医语境里，指体内水湿偏盛；和 humid、damp 这种天气潮湿的含义不同。
entries.definition: Excess dampness 是中医里的证候表述，per TCM 可理解为体内湿邪偏重，常伴有身体沉重、舌苔厚腻、胃口差、水肿感等。说的时候常搭配 in TCM、dampness retention；不要用它单纯形容房间或天气潮湿。

examples.en: My acupuncturist said my fatigue and heavy limbs might be due to excess dampness in TCM, so she suggested avoiding cold and greasy foods.
examples.zh: 我的针灸师说，我乏力、四肢沉重可能是中医里的湿气重，所以建议我少吃生冷和油腻食物。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, a thick greasy tongue coating is often seen as a sign of excess dampness.
examples.zh: 在中医里，舌苔厚腻常被视为湿气重的一个表现。

entries.shortAnswer: 「煎药」英文常说 boil herbal medicine，也作 decoct herbal medicine。boil 指煮沸，decoct 更强调文火慢煎出药性。
entries.definition: 煎药指把中药材加水久煮取汁，英文常用 boil/decoct/brew herbal medicine。中医里 decoction 指煎剂，煎药动作说 decoct the herbs。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, you usually boil herbal medicine in a clay pot over low heat for about an hour.
examples.zh: 在中医里，煎药通常要用砂锅文火煮大约一个小时。

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to boil herbal medicine so that the decoction keeps its full potency.
examples.zh: 我奶奶教我如何煎药，好让药汤保持完整的药效。

entries.shortAnswer: boil herbal medicine 的中文意思是「煎药」，即把中药材加水煮成汤剂，重点是煎煮过程，也常说 decoct herbal medicine。
entries.definition: boil herbal medicine 指用水煎煮中药材，核心词义是「煎药」。boil 强调煮沸，decoct 更正式、特指煎出有效成分。常见搭配：boil/decoct the herbs、a herbal decoction。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, you usually boil herbal medicine in a clay pot over low heat for about an hour.
examples.zh: 在中医里，煎药通常要用砂锅文火煮大约一个小时。

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to boil herbal medicine so that the decoction keeps its full potency.
examples.zh: 我奶奶教我如何煎药，好让药汤保持完整的药效。

entries.shortAnswer: 「经络」的英文是 meridians，指中医理论中气血运行的通道。注意 meridian 在英文里也指经线或子午线，但用于中医时特指经络系统。
entries.definition: 经络是中医核心概念，英文通译 meridians，指人体气血运行、联系脏腑肢节的通道系统。常见搭配：meridian points（经络穴位）、meridian system（经络系统）、blocked meridians（经络不通）。西医解剖学中无对应结构。

examples.en: Acupuncturists believe that inserting needles at specific points can help unblock the meridians and restore the flow of qi.
examples.zh: 针灸师认为，在特定穴位进针有助于疏通经络，恢复气的运行。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, the meridians are seen as a network that connects the internal organs with the surface of the body.
examples.zh: 在中医里，经络被视为连接内脏与体表的网络系统。

entries.shortAnswer: Meridians 中文意思是「经络」，是中医理论中气血运行的通道。不要与地理学中的 meridian（经线）混淆，医学语境下通常指经络系统。
entries.definition: Meridians 在中医语境指经络，是针灸取穴和气血运行的理论骨架。常见搭配：meridian points, meridian system, blocked meridians。日常英语中 meridian 也指经线或子午线，需根据上下文区分。

examples.en: Acupuncturists believe that inserting needles at specific points can help unblock the meridians and restore the flow of qi.
examples.zh: 针灸师认为，在特定穴位进针有助于疏通经络，恢复气的运行。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, the meridians are seen as a network that connects the internal organs with the surface of the body.
examples.zh: 在中医里，经络被视为连接内脏与体表的网络系统。

entries.shortAnswer: 「阴虚」的英文是 yin deficiency，中医指体内阴液不足、滋润不够的证候，常与「阳虚」相对。
entries.definition: yin deficiency 是中医固定译法，指体内阴液亏虚、滋润不足，常见搭配有 kidney yin deficiency、treat yin deficiency。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed him with kidney yin deficiency and recommended a nourishing herbal diet.
examples.zh: 医生诊断他肾阴虚，建议服用滋阴的药膳。

examples.en: Symptoms of yin deficiency often include dry mouth, night sweats, and a feeling of heat in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 阴虚的症状常包括口干、盗汗和午后潮热。

entries.shortAnswer: yin deficiency 的中文意思是「阴虚」，指中医里阴液不足的证候，常伴有虚热表现。
entries.definition: yin deficiency 是中医术语，指阴液亏虚，常搭配 kidney yin deficiency、nourish yin，正式医学语境常用。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed him with kidney yin deficiency and recommended a nourishing herbal diet.
examples.zh: 医生诊断他肾阴虚，建议服用滋阴的药膳。

examples.en: Symptoms of yin deficiency often include dry mouth, night sweats, and a feeling of heat in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 阴虚的症状常包括口干、盗汗和午后潮热。

entries.shortAnswer: 气血不足的英文是 low qi and blood，中医指气虚与血虚并见，常见疲乏、面色差等表现。
entries.definition: 中医证候名，指气虚与血虚同时存在，常表现为疲乏无力、面色苍白或萎黄、头晕、心悸等，不宜直接等同于西医的贫血。

examples.en: After months of overwork, she was diagnosed with low qi and blood, which explained her constant fatigue and pale face.
examples.zh: 劳累几个月后，她被诊断为气血不足，这解释了她持续的疲乏和苍白面色。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, low qi and blood is often treated with rest, herbal decoctions, and a nourishing diet.
examples.zh: 在中医里，气血不足通常通过休息、中药汤剂和滋补饮食来调理。

entries.shortAnswer: Low qi and blood means 气血不足, a TCM pattern of qi and blood deficiency.
entries.definition: A traditional Chinese medicine term for dual qi and blood deficiency, often causing fatigue, a pale face, dizziness, and palpitations.

examples.en: After months of overwork, she was diagnosed with low qi and blood, which explained her constant fatigue and pale face.
examples.zh: 劳累几个月后，她被诊断为气血不足，这解释了她持续的疲乏和苍白面色。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, low qi and blood is often treated with rest, herbal decoctions, and a nourishing diet.
examples.zh: 在中医里，气血不足通常通过休息、中药汤剂和滋补饮食来调理。

entries.shortAnswer: 「药膳」用英语说是 medicinal food。注意它不同于西式 functional food，特指以中医「药食同源」理论为指导、把药材与食材同烹的食补方式，常译 TCM cuisine。
entries.definition: 指在中医理论指导下，将当归、枸杞、黄芪等药材与鸡、粥、汤同煮，以养生防病或辅助调理的膳食。常见搭配：medicinal food therapy、medicinal diet。不要简单等同于 health food 或 supplements。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, medicinal food such as angelica chicken soup is eaten to nourish the blood and boost energy.
examples.zh: 在中医里，像当归炖鸡这样的药膳被用来补血益气。

examples.en: Many families cook medicinal food at home during winter to strengthen the body and prevent illness.
examples.zh: 许多家庭在冬天会在家做药膳，以强身防病。

entries.shortAnswer: medicinal food 的中文是「药膳」：在中医「药食同源」理念下用药材与食材同烹的食补。它强调调理体质，不同于西方泛指添加营养素的功能性食品 functional foods。
entries.definition: 英文 medicinal food 指以传统中医理论配制的食疗膳食，如当归炖鸡、枸杞粥；常见于养生、产后调理语境。口语中也可说 TCM cuisine。勿与 medicine（药物）或 health food（健康食品）混用。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, medicinal food such as angelica chicken soup is eaten to nourish the blood and boost energy.
examples.zh: 在中医里，像当归炖鸡这样的药膳被用来补血益气。

examples.en: Many families cook medicinal food at home during winter to strengthen the body and prevent illness.
examples.zh: 许多家庭在冬天会在家做药膳，以强身防病。

entries.shortAnswer: 枸杞的英文是 goji berries，也可写作 wolfberries；日常养生语境下 goji berries 最常用，欧美超市和健康食品店基本都用这个说法。
entries.definition: goji berries 是英文里已经通行的借词，指中医和养生里常说的枸杞，多用于泡水、煲汤、煮粥。说某人「吃枸杞养生」时直接用 eat goji berries 即可，不必逐字翻译成中文式的 medlar。

examples.en: She adds a handful of goji berries to her tea every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都会往茶里加一小把枸杞。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, goji berries are often used to nourish the liver and kidneys.
examples.zh: 在传统中医里，枸杞常被用来滋补肝肾。

entries.shortAnswer: Goji berries 的中文是枸杞，是传统中医养生里常见的红色小果实；它和 wolfberry 指同一种东西，但 goji berries 是更流行的说法。
entries.definition: goji berries 在英文中多指晒干的枸杞子，常用于泡茶、煮粥或加入汤里，属健康食品语境。它是从中文借入的词，比 wolfberry 更口语、更常见，作可数名词时常用复数。

examples.en: She adds a handful of goji berries to her tea every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都会往茶里加一小把枸杞。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, goji berries are often used to nourish the liver and kidneys.
examples.zh: 在传统中医里，枸杞常被用来滋补肝肾。

entries.shortAnswer: 「阳虚」的英文是 yang deficiency，指阳气不足、温煦减弱；一般不说 deficient yang。
entries.definition: yang deficiency 是中医术语，可搭配肾、脾、心等，如 kidney yang deficiency，常见怕冷、乏力、便溏。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, cold hands and feet may point to a yang deficiency.
examples.zh: 在中医里，手脚冰凉可能提示阳虚。

examples.en: The doctor said his tiredness and loose stools came from spleen yang deficiency.
examples.zh: 医生说他的乏力和大便稀溏是脾阳虚引起的。

entries.shortAnswer: Yang deficiency, or 阳虚, is a TCM pattern of weak warming qi causing cold and fatigue.
entries.definition: In TCM, yang deficiency means insufficient warming energy, often affecting kidney, spleen, or heart and causing cold limbs and tiredness.

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, cold hands and feet may point to a yang deficiency.
examples.zh: 在中医里，手脚冰凉可能提示阳虚。

examples.en: The doctor said his tiredness and loose stools came from spleen yang deficiency.
examples.zh: 医生说他的乏力和大便稀溏是脾阳虚引起的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「穴位」的英文是 acupoints，也可说 acupuncture points。在中医语境中，acupoints 指人体经络上可针刺或按压的特定点位。
entries.definition: acupoints 是针灸学核心术语，常搭配 stimulate、press、locate 等动词。单说 point 太泛，正式医学语境用 acupoint 或 acupuncture point 更准确。

examples.en: The therapist pressed several acupoints on my back to relieve the tension.
examples.zh: 治疗师按压了我背部的几个穴位来缓解紧张。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, acupoints are believed to be connected by meridians.
examples.zh: 在中医理论中，穴位被认为由经络相连。

entries.shortAnswer: Acupoints 的中文意思是「穴位」，即中医经络上可针刺、艾灸或按压的特定点位。它比普通 point 更专业，特指针灸理论中的位点。
entries.definition: acupoints 是针灸学标准用词，常见搭配有 stimulate acupoints、press acupoints、acupoints on the meridian。口语中也可说 acupuncture points，但学术写作多用 acupoint。

examples.en: The therapist pressed several acupoints on my back to relieve the tension.
examples.zh: 治疗师按压了我背部的几个穴位来缓解紧张。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, acupoints are believed to be connected by meridians.
examples.zh: 在中医理论中，穴位被认为由经络相连。

entries.shortAnswer: 泡脚用英语说是 foot soak。日常口语中也可说 soak one's feet，但 foot soak 更常用作名词短语，指泡脚这一行为或一次泡脚。
entries.definition: foot soak 指用热水或药汤浸泡双脚，是中医养生中常见的温经散寒、促进气血运行的方法。动词搭配为 have a foot soak、do a foot soak；若强调动作可用 soak one's feet。注意不要与 foot massage（足部按摩）混淆。

examples.en: After a long day of walking, I like to have a warm foot soak with some ginger and salt before bed.
examples.zh: 走了一整天路后，我喜欢睡前用生姜和盐泡个热水脚。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, a herbal foot soak is often recommended to warm the meridians and improve blood circulation.
examples.zh: 在中医里，药浴泡脚常被推荐用来温通经络、促进气血循环。

entries.shortAnswer: Foot soak 的中文意思是泡脚，即把双脚浸泡在热水或药汤中。它强调浸泡这一养生行为，与 foot bath（泡脚盆/足浴）和 foot massage（足部按摩）侧重不同。
entries.definition: foot soak 作名词指一次泡脚或泡脚疗法，作动词短语可写 soak one's feet。常见搭配：have a foot soak、a warm foot soak、herbal foot soak。在中医养生语境中常与温经散寒、促进循环相关；口语中也可泛指睡前放松泡脚。

examples.en: After a long day of walking, I like to have a warm foot soak with some ginger and salt before bed.
examples.zh: 走了一整天路后，我喜欢睡前用生姜和盐泡个热水脚。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, a herbal foot soak is often recommended to warm the meridians and improve blood circulation.
examples.zh: 在中医里，药浴泡脚常被推荐用来温通经络、促进气血循环。

entries.shortAnswer: 「太极」的英文是 tai chi，这是已被英语词典收录的借词。注意它指武术与养生功法，不指哲学概念「太极」（supreme ultimate）。
entries.definition: tai chi 是英语中通行的音译借词，指太极拳及其养生练法，常搭配 practice tai chi、tai chi class、tai chi chuan。哲学上的「太极」不宜用 tai chi，应说 the supreme ultimate 或 taiji。

examples.en: My grandmother practices tai chi in the park every morning to improve her balance and circulation.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天早上在公园练太极，以改善平衡和血液循环。

examples.en: Doctors in traditional Chinese medicine often recommend tai chi alongside acupuncture for chronic pain.
examples.zh: 中医常建议在针灸之外配合太极来缓解慢性疼痛。

entries.shortAnswer: Tai chi 的中文意思是「太极」，特指太极拳这类缓慢柔和的中国养生功法。它与 qigong 气功相近，但 tai chi 更强调连贯的武术招式与步法。
entries.definition: tai chi 指太极拳，既可作不可数名词（do tai chi），也可作定语（tai chi class）。在传统中医与养生语境中常与气、经络、balance 等词同现，拼写也作 tai chi chuan。

examples.en: My grandmother practices tai chi in the park every morning to improve her balance and circulation.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天早上在公园练太极，以改善平衡和血液循环。

examples.en: Doctors in traditional Chinese medicine often recommend tai chi alongside acupuncture for chronic pain.
examples.zh: 中医常建议在针灸之外配合太极来缓解慢性疼痛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「养生」的英文是 health preservation，指通过饮食、作息、锻炼等方式保养身体、预防疾病。它偏日常保健，不等同于 medical treatment。
entries.definition: health preservation 强调主动维护健康、延年益寿，属中医「治未病」理念。常见搭配：health preservation methods、health preservation in TCM。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, health preservation focuses on preventing illness before it occurs.
examples.zh: 在中医里，养生注重在疾病发生之前就加以预防。

examples.en: She practices health preservation by going to bed early and drinking goji berry tea.
examples.zh: 她通过早睡和喝枸杞茶来养生。

entries.shortAnswer: Health preservation 的中文意思是「养生」，指通过生活方式保养身体、预防疾病，强调日常调理而非治疗。
entries.definition: Health preservation 指为保持健康、延年益寿而进行的饮食、作息、锻炼等日常实践，常用于中医语境，如 health preservation in TCM。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, health preservation focuses on preventing illness before it occurs.
examples.zh: 在中医里，养生注重在疾病发生之前就加以预防。

examples.en: She practices health preservation by going to bed early and drinking goji berry tea.
examples.zh: 她通过早睡和喝枸杞茶来养生。

entries.shortAnswer: 气功的英文是 qigong，已作为借词进入英语，一般不必另找译法，这个拼写也最为通行。
entries.definition: 不可数名词，如 practice qigong、a qigong master；也可拼作 chi kung，但 qigong 更通行。

examples.en: My grandmother practices qigong in the park every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天早上早饭前都在公园里练气功。

examples.en: Doctors of traditional Chinese medicine sometimes recommend qigong to help patients relax.
examples.zh: 中医有时会建议患者练气功，帮助他们放松。

entries.shortAnswer: Qigong 的中文意思是「气功」，一种调息、调身、调心的养生功法，英文里直接写作 qigong。
entries.definition: A mind-body practice of slow movement, breath control, and focused intention, often grouped with tai chi and acupuncture in TCM.

examples.en: My grandmother practices qigong in the park every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 我奶奶每天早上早饭前都在公园里练气功。

examples.en: Doctors of traditional Chinese medicine sometimes recommend qigong to help patients relax.
examples.zh: 中医有时会建议患者练气功，帮助他们放松。

entries.shortAnswer: 「进补」英文是 tonic nourishment，指用滋补食物或药材调养身体。
entries.definition: 指秋冬或病后服用滋补品以增强体质，如冬季进补、药膳进补、大病后进补，属中医调养概念，宜加 per TCM。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, winter is considered the best season for tonic nourishment.
examples.zh: 在中医里，冬季被认为是进补的最佳时节。

examples.en: After the illness, she followed her doctor's advice and turned to tonic nourishment with herbal soups.
examples.zh: 病后她听从医生建议，用药膳汤来进行进补。

entries.shortAnswer: tonic nourishment 中文是「进补」，指按中医用滋补食物或药材调养身体。
entries.definition: 正式书面表达，常见于中医养生与食疗语境，强调滋补调养，对象多为体虚、病后或秋冬养生者，宜点明 per TCM。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, winter is considered the best season for tonic nourishment.
examples.zh: 在中医里，冬季被认为是进补的最佳时节。

examples.en: After the illness, she followed her doctor's advice and turned to tonic nourishment with herbal soups.
examples.zh: 病后她听从医生建议，用药膳汤来进行进补。

entries.shortAnswer: 「药酒」的英文是 medicinal liquor，指将中药材浸泡在白酒或黄酒中制成的保健或治疗用酒。注意 medicinal liquor 强调药用，日常佐餐酒不能这样译。
entries.definition: medicinal liquor 通常指以中药材浸泡的高度酒，用于内服或外敷，按中医理论发挥补益或祛风散寒等作用。常见搭配：drink medicinal liquor、soak herbs in medicinal liquor。不要与 wine 混用，药酒不是葡萄酒。

examples.en: My grandfather always drinks a small cup of medicinal liquor in winter to keep warm.
examples.zh: 我爷爷冬天总会喝一小杯药酒来暖身。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, medicinal liquor is often made by soaking herbs in strong alcohol for months.
examples.zh: 在中医里，药酒通常是将药材浸泡在高度酒中数月制成。

entries.shortAnswer: medicinal liquor 的中文意思是「药酒」，即用中药材浸泡酒液制成的传统养生或疗疾用酒。与普通酒不同，它强调药用目的，常按中医理论配制。
entries.definition: medicinal liquor 指以草药或动物药材浸泡于烈酒中所得的药酒，在中医里用于内服或外用。常见搭配：make/soak medicinal liquor、take medicinal liquor orally。注意它不等同于 wine，也非日常饮品。

examples.en: My grandfather always drinks a small cup of medicinal liquor in winter to keep warm.
examples.zh: 我爷爷冬天总会喝一小杯药酒来暖身。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, medicinal liquor is often made by soaking herbs in strong alcohol for months.
examples.zh: 在中医里，药酒通常是将药材浸泡在高度酒中数月制成。

entries.shortAnswer: 「贴秋膘」英文是 autumn fattening up，指立秋进补，把夏天掉的体重吃回来。
entries.definition: 中国北方立秋民俗，与苦夏相对：夏天食欲差易掉肉，立秋吃炖肉饺子补膘，英文多译作 autumn fattening up。

examples.en: In northern China, people believe in autumn fattening up and eat stewed meat on the day of Start of Autumn.
examples.zh: 在中国北方，人们相信贴秋膘，会在立秋这天吃炖肉。

examples.en: After a summer of poor appetite, my grandmother says it is time for autumn fattening up.
examples.zh: 苦夏之后胃口不好，我奶奶说该贴秋膘了。

entries.shortAnswer: Autumn fattening up 中文叫「贴秋膘」，指立秋后吃肉进补，补回夏天瘦下的体重。
entries.definition: A northern Chinese custom: after Start of Autumn people eat meat to regain weight lost in summer. It renders 贴秋膘, not ordinary weight gain.

examples.en: In northern China, people believe in autumn fattening up and eat stewed meat on the day of Start of Autumn.
examples.zh: 在中国北方，人们相信贴秋膘，会在立秋这天吃炖肉。

examples.en: After a summer of poor appetite, my grandmother says it is time for autumn fattening up.
examples.zh: 苦夏之后胃口不好，我奶奶说该贴秋膘了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「三伏贴」英文常说 dog-days herbal patch，是三伏天穴位贴药的中医外治法。
entries.definition: dog-days herbal patch 中 dog days 对应「三伏」，herbal patch 指药膏贴敷，属中医冬病夏治范畴。

examples.en: Every summer, my grandmother gets dog-days herbal patches at a TCM hospital for her chronic cough.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，我奶奶都去中医院贴三伏贴，治她的老慢支。

examples.en: Doctors say dog-days herbal patches follow the winter-disease-treated-in-summer principle.
examples.zh: 医生说，三伏贴遵循冬病夏治的原理。

entries.shortAnswer: A dog-days herbal patch is 三伏贴 in Chinese: a TCM paste put on acupoints in the hottest summer days.
entries.definition: A dog-days herbal patch is pasted on acupoints during the three fu periods to prevent winter illnesses, not a pain-relief patch.

examples.en: Every summer, my grandmother gets dog-days herbal patches at a TCM hospital for her chronic cough.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，我奶奶都去中医院贴三伏贴，治她的老慢支。

examples.en: Doctors say dog-days herbal patches follow the winter-disease-treated-in-summer principle.
examples.zh: 医生说，三伏贴遵循冬病夏治的原理。

entries.shortAnswer: 凉茶用英语说是 herbal tea，但要注意它特指广东等地用中草药熬制的降火饮品，和西方的 herbal tea（花草茶）不是一回事。
entries.definition: herbal tea 在英语里常指不含咖啡因的花草茶，而中文凉茶是岭南地区用金银花、夏枯草等草药煎煮的饮品，per TCM 有清热解毒之效，点单时可说 a cup of herbal tea。

examples.en: In Guangzhou, it's common to drink a cup of herbal tea when you feel internal heat.
examples.zh: 在广州，人们感觉上火时通常会喝一杯凉茶。

examples.en: This herbal tea is made with honeysuckle and prunella, per traditional Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 这款凉茶是用金银花和夏枯草熬制的，遵循中医理论。

entries.shortAnswer: Herbal tea 的中文意思是凉茶，指用中草药煮成的传统保健饮品，但英语中 herbal tea 也可能指花草茶，需看语境。
entries.definition: herbal tea 泛指用植物叶、花、根冲泡的茶饮，在中医养生语境下对应凉茶，常见搭配 drink herbal tea、a herbal tea blend；注意正式场合用 herbal infusion 更准确。

examples.en: In Guangzhou, it's common to drink a cup of herbal tea when you feel internal heat.
examples.zh: 在广州，人们感觉上火时通常会喝一杯凉茶。

examples.en: This herbal tea is made with honeysuckle and prunella, per traditional Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 这款凉茶是用金银花和夏枯草熬制的，遵循中医理论。

entries.shortAnswer: 「冬病夏治」的英文是 winter illness treated in summer，指趁夏天阳气最盛时防治冬季易发旧疾的中医时间疗法。
entries.definition: 中医指趁夏季阳气最盛时用三伏贴等法，预防冬季易发旧疾。常见搭配：winter illness treated in summer therapy。

examples.en: According to traditional Chinese medicine, winter illness treated in summer uses the hottest days to prevent chronic conditions from flaring up in cold months.
examples.zh: 根据中医，冬病夏治利用一年中最热的时节，预防慢性病在寒冷月份复发。

examples.en: Many patients try winter illness treated in summer therapy because they want fewer asthma attacks when winter comes.
examples.zh: 许多患者尝试冬病夏治疗法，希望入冬后哮喘发作少一些。

entries.shortAnswer: winter illness treated in summer 的中文是「冬病夏治」，指趁夏天阳气最盛时防治冬季易发旧疾的中医时间疗法。
entries.definition: In TCM, winter illness treated in summer means preventing cold-season ailments during the hottest days. 常见搭配：therapy。

examples.en: According to traditional Chinese medicine, winter illness treated in summer uses the hottest days to prevent chronic conditions from flaring up in cold months.
examples.zh: 根据中医，冬病夏治利用一年中最热的时节，预防慢性病在寒冷月份复发。

examples.en: Many patients try winter illness treated in summer therapy because they want fewer asthma attacks when winter comes.
examples.zh: 许多患者尝试冬病夏治疗法，希望入冬后哮喘发作少一些。

entries.shortAnswer: 足疗最常译作 foot massage，但多指足部按摩，非中医足底针灸或反射疗法。
entries.definition: foot massage 指足部按摩，偏放松保健；中医语境下可指足部推拿，常见搭配 get a foot massage。

examples.en: After walking all day, I booked a foot massage to relax my tired feet.
examples.zh: 走了一整天后，我预约了足疗来放松疲惫的双脚。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, a foot massage is often used to improve circulation and promote wellness.
examples.zh: 在中医里，足疗常被用来促进血液循环、增进健康。

entries.shortAnswer: “足疗” is usually foot massage: a relaxing or health-focused massage of the feet.
entries.definition: Foot massage means rubbing the feet to relax or promote health. In TCM, it can mean foot tuina; not reflexology.

examples.en: After walking all day, I booked a foot massage to relax my tired feet.
examples.zh: 走了一整天后，我预约了足疗来放松疲惫的双脚。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, a foot massage is often used to improve circulation and promote wellness.
examples.zh: 在中医里，足疗常被用来促进血液循环、增进健康。

entries.shortAnswer: 「太极招式」的英文是 tai chi moves。在中医养生语境中，该词指太极拳的单个动作或整套动作序列，也可用 tai chi forms 或 tai chi postures。
entries.definition: tai chi moves 是英语中对太极招式的通用说法，常用于健身、养生和武术教学。注意：单招可称 a tai chi move，整套套路常称 tai chi form 或 tai chi sequence；moves 更强调动作本身。

examples.en: The instructor broke down the tai chi moves so that beginners could follow along.
examples.zh: 教练把太极招式分解开，让初学者能够跟上。

examples.en: She practices tai chi moves every morning to improve her balance and relax her mind.
examples.zh: 她每天早上练习太极招式，以改善平衡并放松心情。

entries.shortAnswer: 「tai chi moves」的中文意思是「太极招式」。它指太极拳中的动作或招式，与 tai chi forms 近义，但 moves 更侧重单个动作，forms 更侧重完整套路。
entries.definition: tai chi moves 指太极拳的招式或动作，常见搭配有 learn tai chi moves、practice tai chi moves、basic tai chi moves。口语和教学场合常用；若指整套拳架，用 tai chi form 更准确。

examples.en: The instructor broke down the tai chi moves so that beginners could follow along.
examples.zh: 教练把太极招式分解开，让初学者能够跟上。

examples.en: She practices tai chi moves every morning to improve her balance and relax her mind.
examples.zh: 她每天早上练习太极招式，以改善平衡并放松心情。

entries.shortAnswer: 大结局的英文是 series finale，特指整部剧的最后一集。注意别和季终集 season finale 搞混，后者只是某一季的结尾。
entries.definition: series finale 指一部剧集彻底完结的最后一集，常伴随剧情收束与彩蛋。口语中也可说 the final episode，但 series finale 更强调"全剧终"。

examples.en: Fans were devastated by the series finale, calling it a botched ending that ruined years of character development.
examples.zh: 粉丝们被大结局虐得不轻，直呼烂尾，毁掉了多年的角色成长。

examples.en: After the series finale aired, the showrunner confirmed there would be no reunion or post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 大结局播出后，剧集主管确认不会再有重聚或片尾彩蛋。

entries.shortAnswer: Series finale 中文意思是"大结局"，指一部电视剧的最后一集。它与 season finale（季终集）不同，后者只是一季的结束，剧集可能还会续订。
entries.definition: Series finale 指整部剧的最终集，常用于美剧语境。搭配如 watch the series finale、the series finale aired。注意与 series final（剧集最后一场戏）和 season finale 区分。

examples.en: Fans were devastated by the series finale, calling it a botched ending that ruined years of character development.
examples.zh: 粉丝们被大结局虐得不轻，直呼烂尾，毁掉了多年的角色成长。

examples.en: After the series finale aired, the showrunner confirmed there would be no reunion or post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 大结局播出后，剧集主管确认不会再有重聚或片尾彩蛋。

entries.shortAnswer: 「更新」在影视追剧语境常译为 release new episodes，指平台放出新剧集，强调官方按排播上线。
entries.definition: 指平台按排播放出新剧集，常见搭配：release new episodes weekly（每周更新）、release new episodes on Fridays（周五更新）。

examples.en: The streaming platform will release new episodes every Friday at 8 p.m., with early access for VIP members.
examples.zh: 该流媒体平台每周五晚八点更新新剧集，会员可抢先看。

examples.en: Fans were thrilled when the showrunner confirmed they would release new episodes after the mid-season finale.
examples.zh: 剧集主管确认冬歇大结局后会继续更新新剧集，粉丝们兴奋不已。

entries.shortAnswer: release new episodes 中文意思是「更新」，指影视平台按计划放出新剧集，区别于 leak 和 upload。
entries.definition: 核心义：官方发布新剧集。搭配：release new episodes weekly（每周更新）、release new episodes on Fridays（周五更新）。

examples.en: The streaming platform will release new episodes every Friday at 8 p.m., with early access for VIP members.
examples.zh: 该流媒体平台每周五晚八点更新新剧集，会员可抢先看。

examples.en: Fans were thrilled when the showrunner confirmed they would release new episodes after the mid-season finale.
examples.zh: 剧集主管确认冬歇大结局后会继续更新新剧集，粉丝们兴奋不已。

entries.shortAnswer: 「剧透」的英文是 spoiler，指提前泄露关键剧情。注意它是名词，动词用 spoil；说「别剧透」常用 No spoilers。
entries.definition: spoiler 多指泄露电影、剧集或小说关键情节的信息，常见搭配有 spoiler alert（剧透预警）、avoid spoilers（避开剧透）。作「剧透」义时是可数名词，如 a big spoiler；不要与动词 spoil（破坏、扫兴）混淆。

examples.en: Please don't post any spoilers about the series finale; I haven't watched it yet.
examples.zh: 请别发任何关于大结局的剧透，我还没看呢。

examples.en: She accidentally read a spoiler online and then decided to drop the show.
examples.zh: 她不小心在网上看到一条剧透，然后决定弃剧了。

entries.shortAnswer: “spoiler”的中文意思是「剧透」，即提前泄露关键剧情的信息。它作名词用，动词是 spoil；日常说“别剧透”常说 No spoilers。
entries.definition: spoiler 作名词，指泄露剧情的信息，常见搭配 spoiler alert、avoid spoilers、post a spoiler。口语和网络语境常用；注意它也可指汽车扰流板，但影视语境下几乎都指剧透。

examples.en: Please don't post any spoilers about the series finale; I haven't watched it yet.
examples.zh: 请别发任何关于大结局的剧透，我还没看呢。

examples.en: She accidentally read a spoiler online and then decided to drop the show.
examples.zh: 她不小心在网上看到一条剧透，然后决定弃剧了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「彩蛋」在影视里常指 post-credits scene，即片尾字幕后的隐藏片段。
entries.definition: 「彩蛋」指片尾字幕滚动后出现的隐藏片段，英文叫 post-credits scene，常为续集铺垫或搞笑。

examples.en: Don't leave the theater yet—there's a post-credits scene that sets up the sequel.
examples.zh: 先别离开影院——片尾字幕后面有个彩蛋，为续集埋下了伏笔。

examples.en: Fans rewatched the movie just to spot every Easter egg, even the one hidden in the post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 粉丝们为了找出每一个彩蛋而二刷这部电影，连片尾字幕后的那个隐藏彩蛋也不放过。

entries.shortAnswer: The Chinese word 「彩蛋」 often means a post-credits scene, a hidden clip after the credits.
entries.definition: A post-credits scene, called 「彩蛋」 in Chinese, is a short clip after the credits, often teasing a sequel.

examples.en: Don't leave the theater yet—there's a post-credits scene that sets up the sequel.
examples.zh: 先别离开影院——片尾字幕后面有个彩蛋，为续集埋下了伏笔。

examples.en: Fans rewatched the movie just to spot every Easter egg, even the one hidden in the post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 粉丝们为了找出每一个彩蛋而二刷这部电影，连片尾字幕后的那个隐藏彩蛋也不放过。

entries.shortAnswer: 「腰斩」的英文是 cancel a series，指剧集在播出中途被平台砍掉。注意区分字面义 cut in half，追剧语境下不说 cut in half。
entries.definition: 专指美剧或国产剧因收视、成本等原因在季中途被砍，不拍完原定集数，也常说 be axed、get cancelled mid-season。与正常完结的 series finale 不同，腰斩常导致剧情烂尾。

examples.en: Fans were furious when the streaming platform decided to cancel a series mid-season, leaving the plot unresolved.
examples.zh: 当流媒体平台决定中途腰斩这部剧、留下未解的剧情时，粉丝们非常愤怒。

examples.en: The network cancelled a series that had strong ratings but a budget too high to sustain.
examples.zh: 电视网腰斩了一部收视不错但制作成本高得难以维持的剧集。

entries.shortAnswer: cancel a series 的中文意思是「腰斩」，特指剧集在连载中途被平台砍掉。它不同于剧终，暗示没拍完就草草收场。
entries.definition: 动词短语，指电视台或流媒体停止续订并中止一部剧的播出。常见搭配：the show was cancelled、cancel a series after one season。口语也说 axed；字面「切成两半」用 cut in half。

examples.en: Fans were furious when the streaming platform decided to cancel a series mid-season, leaving the plot unresolved.
examples.zh: 当流媒体平台决定中途腰斩这部剧、留下未解的剧情时，粉丝们非常愤怒。

examples.en: The network cancelled a series that had strong ratings but a budget too high to sustain.
examples.zh: 电视网腰斩了一部收视不错但制作成本高得难以维持的剧集。

entries.shortAnswer: 「番外」在英文里常说 side story，指主线之外单独成篇的补充故事。注意别用 extra episode，那只是集数加更，不含剧情分支义。
entries.definition: 常见搭配 a side story to the main series，也可说 drop a side story。影视讨论中指正片之外的衍生剧情，常与彩蛋、客串一起出现，区别于续订、杀青等制作环节用语。

examples.en: Fans begged the studio to turn that popular side story into a full spin-off after the series finale.
examples.zh: 大结局播出后，粉丝们纷纷请求制片方把那个高人气番外拍成完整的衍生剧。

examples.en: I rewatched the whole show, but I skipped the side story because it spoiled the main couple's ending.
examples.zh: 我二刷了整部剧，但跳过了那个番外，因为它剧透了主角情侣的结局。

entries.shortAnswer: side story 的中文意思是「番外」，指脱离主线、单独成篇的补充故事。它强调剧情分支，而 bonus episode 只强调额外加更的那一集。
entries.definition: 核心义为与主线并行或补充的支线故事，常见搭配 a side story、side stories；与 spin-off 近义，但后者更侧重独立衍生剧。剧迷也常说 the side story arc。

examples.en: Fans begged the studio to turn that popular side story into a full spin-off after the series finale.
examples.zh: 大结局播出后，粉丝们纷纷请求制片方把那个高人气番外拍成完整的衍生剧。

examples.en: I rewatched the whole show, but I skipped the side story because it spoiled the main couple's ending.
examples.zh: 我二刷了整部剧，但跳过了那个番外，因为它剧透了主角情侣的结局。

entries.shortAnswer: 「烂尾」的英文是 botched ending，指剧集结局收得差，让观众大失所望。
entries.definition: botched ending 常指影视剧大结局拍砸了，口语中也可说 the ending was botched。botched 突出「搞砸了」的意味，可与 rushed ending（仓促收尾）区分。

examples.en: Fans flooded the comments after the series finale, calling it a botched ending that ruined years of build-up.
examples.zh: 大结局播出后粉丝们刷爆评论区，称其烂尾，毁了多年的铺垫。

examples.en: I was about to rewatch the show, but I remembered its botched ending and dropped the idea.
examples.zh: 我本来想二刷这部剧，但一想到它烂尾就打消了念头。

entries.shortAnswer: A botched ending is 烂尾 in Chinese, meaning a show ends so badly that viewers feel let down.
entries.definition: A botched ending is a film or series finale handled so poorly that it disappoints viewers and cheapens what came before.

examples.en: Fans flooded the comments after the series finale, calling it a botched ending that ruined years of build-up.
examples.zh: 大结局播出后粉丝们刷爆评论区，称其烂尾，毁了多年的铺垫。

examples.en: I was about to rewatch the show, but I remembered its botched ending and dropped the idea.
examples.zh: 我本来想二刷这部剧，但一想到它烂尾就打消了念头。

entries.shortAnswer: 「追更」的英文是 follow new episodes，指持续跟进剧集新集数更新。注意它强调追着更新看，不等于 bingewatch（一次性刷完）。
entries.definition: 常用于流媒体语境，如 follow new episodes weekly（每周追更）。想强调等更新可说 wait for new episodes；会员抢先看是 early access；与一次性刷完的 binge-watch 不同。

examples.en: I follow new episodes of this drama every Friday, and I always avoid spoilers before I watch.
examples.zh: 我每周五都追更这部剧，看之前总是尽量避开剧透。

examples.en: She stopped following new episodes after the botched ending, but she still plans to rewatch the early seasons.
examples.zh: 烂尾之后她就不再追更了，不过还是打算二刷前面的几季。

entries.shortAnswer: follow new episodes 的中文意思是「追更」，指一集集跟着更新看剧。它与 binge-watch 不同，后者是把已出的集数一次性刷完。
entries.definition: 动词短语，多用于流媒体和粉丝圈，如 follow new episodes of a show。口语常说 follow the show；强调准时等更新用 wait for new episodes。不表示一次看完。

examples.en: I follow new episodes of this drama every Friday, and I always avoid spoilers before I watch.
examples.zh: 我每周五都追更这部剧，看之前总是尽量避开剧透。

examples.en: She stopped following new episodes after the botched ending, but she still plans to rewatch the early seasons.
examples.zh: 烂尾之后她就不再追更了，不过还是打算二刷前面的几季。

entries.shortAnswer: 「下架」的英文是 pulled from streaming，指内容从流媒体平台被移除，常因版权或争议。
entries.definition: pulled from streaming 指影视内容被平台下架，通常因版权到期、合约终止或引发争议。

examples.en: After the controversy, the entire season was pulled from streaming.
examples.zh: 争议发生后，整季内容被下架。

examples.en: Many classic films have been pulled from streaming as licensing deals expire.
examples.zh: 随着版权协议到期，许多经典影片被下架。

entries.shortAnswer: pulled from streaming 的中文意思是「下架」，即内容从流媒体平台被移除，常因版权或争议所致。
entries.definition: pulled from streaming means content is removed from a streaming platform, often due to licensing expiry or controversy.

examples.en: After the controversy, the entire season was pulled from streaming.
examples.zh: 争议发生后，整季内容被下架。

examples.en: Many classic films have been pulled from streaming as licensing deals expire.
examples.zh: 随着版权协议到期，许多经典影片被下架。

entries.shortAnswer: 「续订」的英文是 renew a series，指平台官方决定继续制作某剧的下一季。
entries.definition: renew a series 指平台正式决定继续制作某剧下一季，常用被动 be renewed for a new season，名词为 renewal，反义为 cancel a series 砍剧。

examples.en: Fans were thrilled when the streaming platform decided to renew a series that everyone thought would be canceled.
examples.zh: 当流媒体平台决定续订这部大家都以为会被砍的剧时，粉丝们激动不已。

examples.en: The show was renewed for a third season after the series finale pulled in record ratings.
examples.zh: 在这部剧的大结局创下收视纪录后，该剧被续订了第三季。

entries.shortAnswer: renew a series 就是「续订」，指电视台或流媒体官方决定再拍下一季。
entries.definition: renew a series 意为「续订」：平台官方决定再制作一季，常用被动 be renewed for a new season，名词是 renewal。

examples.en: Fans were thrilled when the streaming platform decided to renew a series that everyone thought would be canceled.
examples.zh: 当流媒体平台决定续订这部大家都以为会被砍的剧时，粉丝们激动不已。

examples.en: The show was renewed for a third season after the series finale pulled in record ratings.
examples.zh: 在这部剧的大结局创下收视纪录后，该剧被续订了第三季。

entries.shortAnswer: 「补剧」的英文是 catch up on a show，指追上之前没看的剧集。注意它强调赶进度，不是重看，别和 rewatch（二刷）混用。
entries.definition: catch up on a show 常用于口语，指把落下的剧集补看追上进度，也可说 catch up on a series。补完最新一集可以说 I'm all caught up。注意 catch up on 后接剧名或 a show，别只说 catch up a show。

examples.en: I spent the whole weekend catching up on a show that everyone at work keeps talking about, but I still have to avoid spoilers until I finish the series finale.
examples.zh: 我整个周末都在补剧，就是同事老聊的那部，但在看完大结局之前我还得躲着剧透。

examples.en: If you want to catch up on a show before the new season drops, don't just fast-forward through the post-credits scene—there might be a cameo that matters later.
examples.zh: 如果你想在新一季上线前补剧，别快进跳过彩蛋，那里可能有后面剧情相关的客串。

entries.shortAnswer: catch up on a show 的中文意思是「补剧」，指把没看的剧集补上、追上最新进度。它强调追赶进度，不同于 rewatch（二刷）或 binge-watch（刷剧）。
entries.definition: catch up on a show 是口语常用短语，指补看落下的剧集以追上进度。常见搭配：catch up on a series、be all caught up。注意与 binge-watch（一口气刷很多集）和 rewatch（重看）语义不同，后接宾语时用 on。

examples.en: I spent the whole weekend catching up on a show that everyone at work keeps talking about, but I still have to avoid spoilers until I finish the series finale.
examples.zh: 我整个周末都在补剧，就是同事老聊的那部，但在看完大结局之前我还得躲着剧透。

examples.en: If you want to catch up on a show before the new season drops, don't just fast-forward through the post-credits scene—there might be a cameo that matters later.
examples.zh: 如果你想在新一季上线前补剧，别快进跳过彩蛋，那里可能有后面剧情相关的客串。

entries.shortAnswer: 「弃剧」的英文是 drop a show，指看了一部分后主动不再追这部剧，强调自己放弃，不是被平台砍。
entries.definition: drop a show 口语常用，主语是人，宾语是剧。常见搭配：drop a show halfway、drop it after season one；与 be cancelled（平台砍剧）方向不同。

examples.en: I dropped that show after three episodes because the plot was too slow.
examples.zh: 我看三集就弃剧了，因为剧情太拖沓。

examples.en: She rarely drops a show halfway; she always stays for the series finale.
examples.zh: 她很少看到一半弃剧，总会坚持看到大结局。

entries.shortAnswer: drop a show 的意思是「弃剧」，指看了一部分后主动不再追，强调观众自己的选择，而不是平台把剧砍掉。
entries.definition: drop a show 是口语表达，常见于流媒体讨论，如 drop a show halfway、drop it after two episodes；比 stop watching 更强调彻底放弃。

examples.en: I dropped that show after three episodes because the plot was too slow.
examples.zh: 我看三集就弃剧了，因为剧情太拖沓。

examples.en: She rarely drops a show halfway; she always stays for the series finale.
examples.zh: 她很少看到一半弃剧，总会坚持看到大结局。

entries.shortAnswer: 「导演剪辑版」的英文是 director's cut，指导演按自己意图最终剪辑的版本。
entries.definition: director's cut 指导演掌握最终剪辑权后推出的版本，与 theatrical cut（院线版）相对，但不一定是加长版。

examples.en: The director's cut adds a crucial scene that explains the villain's motivation, so fans consider it the definitive version.
examples.zh: 导演剪辑版增加了一场解释反派动机的关键戏，因此影迷认为这个版本才是最终定版。

examples.en: After the studio forced a happy ending, the director's cut restored the bleak finale the filmmaker originally intended.
examples.zh: 在制片方强行加入大团圆结局之后，导演剪辑版恢复了导演原本想要的灰暗大结局。

entries.shortAnswer: director's cut 的中文意思是「导演剪辑版」，指按导演意图剪辑的版本。
entries.definition: director's cut 是名词短语，与 theatrical cut（院线版）相对，关键在于剪辑决定权在导演而非制片方。

examples.en: The director's cut adds a crucial scene that explains the villain's motivation, so fans consider it the definitive version.
examples.zh: 导演剪辑版增加了一场解释反派动机的关键戏，因此影迷认为这个版本才是最终定版。

examples.en: After the studio forced a happy ending, the director's cut restored the bleak finale the filmmaker originally intended.
examples.zh: 在制片方强行加入大团圆结局之后，导演剪辑版恢复了导演原本想要的灰暗大结局。

entries.shortAnswer: 「二刷」指把看过的剧或电影再看一遍，英文说 rewatch，强调重复观看同一内容，常带剧透提醒。
entries.definition: rewatch 可作动词和名词，如 rewatch the finale、a rewatch of season one。想说「我要二刷」可用 I'm going to rewatch it。

examples.en: I'm going to rewatch the series finale tonight to catch all the details I missed the first time.
examples.zh: 我今晚打算二刷大结局，把第一次没注意到的细节都找出来。

examples.en: She did a full rewatch of the show before the new season dropped, and she still cried at the post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 新一季上线前她把这部剧完整二刷了一遍，看到彩蛋时还是哭了。

entries.shortAnswer: Rewatch 就是「二刷」，把看过的剧集或电影再看一遍，强调重复观看，不同于 binge-watch。
entries.definition: rewatch 作动词表示重新观看，作名词指重复观看，如 a rewatch of the finale。常见搭配有 rewatch a show、do a rewatch。

examples.en: I'm going to rewatch the series finale tonight to catch all the details I missed the first time.
examples.zh: 我今晚打算二刷大结局，把第一次没注意到的细节都找出来。

examples.en: She did a full rewatch of the show before the new season dropped, and she still cried at the post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 新一季上线前她把这部剧完整二刷了一遍，看到彩蛋时还是哭了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「预告片」的英文是 trailer，指影视作品上线前发布的宣传短片，用来吸引观众。
entries.definition: trailer 是可数名词，常见搭配有 drop a trailer、official trailer、teaser trailer；teaser 更短、剧透更少。

examples.en: The official trailer for the new season dropped yesterday, and fans are already looking for hidden clues about the series finale.
examples.zh: 新一季的官方预告片昨天发布了，粉丝们已经在寻找关于大结局的隐藏线索。

examples.en: I always rewatch the trailer a few times to catch any cameo or post-credits scene before the show premieres.
examples.zh: 剧集上线前，我总会把预告片重刷几遍，好找出里面的客串或片尾彩蛋。

entries.shortAnswer: “trailer”的中文意思是「预告片」，即影视上线前发布的宣传短片，用来吸引观众。
entries.definition: trailer 是可数名词，常见搭配有 watch the trailer、official trailer；注意它也可指“拖车”。

examples.en: The official trailer for the new season dropped yesterday, and fans are already looking for hidden clues about the series finale.
examples.zh: 新一季的官方预告片昨天发布了，粉丝们已经在寻找关于大结局的隐藏线索。

examples.en: I always rewatch the trailer a few times to catch any cameo or post-credits scene before the show premieres.
examples.zh: 剧集上线前，我总会把预告片重刷几遍，好找出里面的客串或片尾彩蛋。

entries.shortAnswer: 票房在英文里说 box office，指一部电影通过售票获得的总收入，也可指卖票的地方。
entries.definition: box office 作票房讲时多与 hit、top 搭配，如登顶票房榜、票房大卖；也可指售票处，靠上下文区分。

examples.en: The low-budget drama surprisingly topped the box office for three weeks.
examples.zh: 这部小成本剧情片出人意料地连续三周登顶票房榜。

examples.en: Despite mixed reviews, the sequel broke box office records overseas.
examples.zh: 尽管评价褒贬不一，这部续集在海外依然打破了票房纪录。

entries.shortAnswer: Box office means 票房, the ticket sales revenue of a film, and can also mean the ticket counter.
entries.definition: Box office is the money a film earns from ticket sales, as in topped the box office. It can also mean the ticket counter.

examples.en: The low-budget drama surprisingly topped the box office for three weeks.
examples.zh: 这部小成本剧情片出人意料地连续三周登顶票房榜。

examples.en: Despite mixed reviews, the sequel broke box office records overseas.
examples.zh: 尽管评价褒贬不一，这部续集在海外依然打破了票房纪录。

entries.shortAnswer: 「影评」的英文是 film review，指对一部电影的评价文章，不是观众短评或评分。
entries.definition: film review 指专业或较正式的影评文章，常见搭配 write/publish/read a film review。若指观众短评、打分，用 rating 或 user review 更准确。

examples.en: I read a film review before watching the movie, but it contained a major spoiler about the ending.
examples.zh: 我在看电影前读了一篇影评，但里面包含关于结局的重大剧透。

examples.en: Her film review praised the cameo and the post-credits scene, but criticized the botched ending.
examples.zh: 她的影评称赞了客串和彩蛋，但批评了烂尾结局。

entries.shortAnswer: Film review 的中文意思是「影评」，强调对电影的评价文章，不同于只给星级的 rating。
entries.definition: film review 指对电影进行分析、评价的文章，常见搭配 write a film review、get good film reviews。美式口语常说 movie review。

examples.en: I read a film review before watching the movie, but it contained a major spoiler about the ending.
examples.zh: 我在看电影前读了一篇影评，但里面包含关于结局的重大剧透。

examples.en: Her film review praised the cameo and the post-credits scene, but criticized the botched ending.
examples.zh: 她的影评称赞了客串和彩蛋，但批评了烂尾结局。

entries.shortAnswer: 「杀青」的英文是 wrap up filming，指影视作品拍摄全部完成。源自古代竹简烤青去汗的工序，英文口语常说 That's a wrap。
entries.definition: 杀青强调全片拍摄结束，不等于上映或播出。常见搭配：正式宣布杀青、剧组杀青。易错点：杀青是拍摄完成，不是后期制作完成。

examples.en: After six months on set, the director finally announced that they would wrap up filming next week.
examples.zh: 在片场拍摄六个月后，导演终于宣布他们下周杀青。

examples.en: Fans are already guessing the plot after the cast wrapped up filming for the new season.
examples.zh: 演员们为新一季杀青后，粉丝们已经开始猜测剧情了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「wrap up filming」的中文意思是「杀青」，指拍摄全部完成。与 finish shooting 近义，但 wrap 更口语，还常说 That's a wrap。
entries.definition: wrap up filming 指影视拍摄阶段结束，正式或非正式均可。名词形式是 the wrap，口语说 That's a wrap。易错点：不表示上映或播出，只表示拍完。

examples.en: After six months on set, the director finally announced that they would wrap up filming next week.
examples.zh: 在片场拍摄六个月后，导演终于宣布他们下周杀青。

examples.en: Fans are already guessing the plot after the cast wrapped up filming for the new season.
examples.zh: 演员们为新一季杀青后，粉丝们已经开始猜测剧情了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「开机」的英文是 start filming，指影视项目正式开拍，与「杀青」相对。
entries.definition: start filming 指进入拍摄阶段，常见搭配 start filming on a new series。

examples.en: The cast announced that the sequel will start filming in Vancouver next spring, with a cameo from the original lead.
examples.zh: 剧组宣布续集将于明年春天在温哥华开机，原主演会客串。

examples.en: Fans were thrilled when the showrunner confirmed they would start filming the series finale after the midseason break.
examples.zh: 剧集主管确认中期休假后就会开机拍摄大结局，粉丝们兴奋不已。

entries.shortAnswer: “start filming” means 开机, the official start of shooting a film or TV series.
entries.definition: Start filming is a neutral term for beginning production, as in “The series will start filming next month.”

examples.en: The cast announced that the sequel will start filming in Vancouver next spring, with a cameo from the original lead.
examples.zh: 剧组宣布续集将于明年春天在温哥华开机，原主演会客串。

examples.en: Fans were thrilled when the showrunner confirmed they would start filming the series finale after the midseason break.
examples.zh: 剧集主管确认中期休假后就会开机拍摄大结局，粉丝们兴奋不已。

entries.shortAnswer: 字幕组的英文是 fansub group，指爱好者自发翻译并压制字幕的团体。注意它特指非官方、常游走版权灰色地带的民间组织。
entries.definition: fansub group 多指中国网络文化中「为爱发电」的字幕组，常见搭配如 join a fansub group。与 official subtitles 相对，常涉及版权风险，但社区贡献巨大。

examples.en: I always wait for the fansub group to release the new episode before watching it.
examples.zh: 我总是等字幕组发布新一集后才看。

examples.en: That fansub group is famous for adding detailed cultural notes to every show.
examples.zh: 那个字幕组以给每部剧添加详细文化注释而闻名。

entries.shortAnswer: fansub group 的中文意思是「字幕组」，指自发翻译并制作字幕的爱好者团体。它强调非官方、非营利，常与版权争议相伴。
entries.definition: fansub group 指爱好者自发翻译、配字幕并分享的团队，常出现在影视追剧语境。注意与 official subtitling team 区分，后者受版权方授权。

examples.en: I always wait for the fansub group to release the new episode before watching it.
examples.zh: 我总是等字幕组发布新一集后才看。

examples.en: That fansub group is famous for adding detailed cultural notes to every show.
examples.zh: 那个字幕组以给每部剧添加详细文化注释而闻名。

entries.shortAnswer: 「会员抢先看」的英文是 early access for members，指视频平台会员可比普通用户提前观看剧集。注意它强调「提前观看」，不是免费观看。
entries.definition: 常见于中国视频平台的会员权益描述，如「会员抢先看两集」。英文还可说 early access for VIP users；与 exclusive 不同，抢先看侧重时间提前，内容最终会对所有人开放。

examples.en: The streaming platform offers early access for members, so they can watch the first two episodes before everyone else.
examples.zh: 该流媒体平台提供会员抢先看，会员可以比其他人提前观看前两集。

examples.en: Fans are debating the series finale, but early access for members means only subscribers know the ending so far.
examples.zh: 粉丝们正在讨论大结局，但会员抢先看意味着目前只有订阅用户知道结局。

entries.shortAnswer: early access for members 的中文意思是「会员抢先看」，指付费会员能比普通观众提前观看剧集。它强调时间上的优先权，而非内容独占。
entries.definition: 用于描述流媒体或视频平台的会员特权，常与剧集、大结局、彩蛋等搭配。口语中也可说 early access for subscribers；注意 members 不必译成「成员」，此处指平台会员。

examples.en: The streaming platform offers early access for members, so they can watch the first two episodes before everyone else.
examples.zh: 该流媒体平台提供会员抢先看，会员可以比其他人提前观看前两集。

examples.en: Fans are debating the series finale, but early access for members means only subscribers know the ending so far.
examples.zh: 粉丝们正在讨论大结局，但会员抢先看意味着目前只有订阅用户知道结局。

entries.shortAnswer: 「客串」的英文是 cameo appearance，常指明星在影视中短暂露脸。注意：它不是主演或配角，时长极短，通常不列在主要演员表中。
entries.definition: cameo appearance 多指知名演员、导演或歌手在片中惊喜亮相，常与 make a cameo appearance 搭配。与 guest star 不同，客串戏份极少，甚至只有几秒，且常被用作彩蛋。

examples.en: The director made a cameo appearance in the final episode, which fans spotted immediately.
examples.zh: 导演在大结局中客串了一把，粉丝们立刻认了出来。

examples.en: She had a brief cameo appearance in the post-credits scene, setting up a possible sequel.
examples.zh: 她在片尾彩蛋中短暂客串，为可能的续集埋下伏笔。

entries.shortAnswer: Cameo appearance 的中文意思是「客串」，指名人或演员在影视中短暂露面。与 guest star 不同，cameo 戏份极短，通常不参与主线剧情。
entries.definition: cameo appearance 指知名人物在电影、剧集或游戏中短暂出镜，常作为彩蛋或致敬。搭配：make a cameo appearance。口语中可简称为 cameo。注意：它不指常规配角或客串多集的重要角色。

examples.en: The director made a cameo appearance in the final episode, which fans spotted immediately.
examples.zh: 导演在大结局中客串了一把，粉丝们立刻认了出来。

examples.en: She had a brief cameo appearance in the post-credits scene, setting up a possible sequel.
examples.zh: 她在片尾彩蛋中短暂客串，为可能的续集埋下伏笔。

entries.shortAnswer: 「正版」在影视语境里说 official release，指官方正式授权发行的片源或剧集。
entries.definition: official release 指版权方授权上线的完整版本，与枪版、泄露版相对。追剧时用 wait for the official release 表示等正版播出。

examples.en: I'd rather wait for the official release than watch a shaky cam recorded in a cinema.
examples.zh: 我宁愿等正版上线，也不想看那种在影院偷录的枪版。

examples.en: The streaming platform announced the official release date, so fans can finally stop asking when the new season drops.
examples.zh: 流媒体平台公布了正版上线日期，粉丝们终于不用再追问新一季什么时候播了。

entries.shortAnswer: Official release means 正版, content from authorized channels, not leaked copies.
entries.definition: Official release is a version authorized and distributed by the copyright holder. It contrasts with leaks and pirated copies.

examples.en: I'd rather wait for the official release than watch a shaky cam recorded in a cinema.
examples.zh: 我宁愿等正版上线，也不想看那种在影院偷录的枪版。

examples.en: The streaming platform announced the official release date, so fans can finally stop asking when the new season drops.
examples.zh: 流媒体平台公布了正版上线日期，粉丝们终于不用再追问新一季什么时候播了。
