entries.shortAnswer: 「翻拍」的英文是 remake；它指对已有影视作品的重新拍摄，常带全新演员与制作，不是续集。
entries.definition: 翻拍可作名词或动词，常用搭配 a remake of...、remake a classic；注意别与续集 sequel、重启 reboot 混用，翻拍是重讲同一故事。

examples.en: The studio announced a remake of the classic sitcom, but fans are worried it will spoil the original and drop a show after one season.
examples.zh: 制片方宣布翻拍这部经典情景喜剧，但粉丝担心它会破坏原作，而且可能一季就被弃剧。

examples.en: After the series finale got a botched ending, many viewers chose to rewatch the original instead of watching the new remake.
examples.zh: 大结局烂尾之后，许多观众选择二刷原版，而不是看新版翻拍。

entries.shortAnswer: 「remake」的中文意思是「翻拍」；它指重新拍摄已有影视作品，核心是同一故事的新版本，而不是后续剧情。
entries.definition: remake 可作名词或动词，常见搭配 a remake of...、remake a film；正式与口语都可用，易与 sequel 续集、reboot 重启混淆。

examples.en: The studio announced a remake of the classic sitcom, but fans are worried it will spoil the original and drop a show after one season.
examples.zh: 制片方宣布翻拍这部经典情景喜剧，但粉丝担心它会破坏原作，而且可能一季就被弃剧。

examples.en: After the series finale got a botched ending, many viewers chose to rewatch the original instead of watching the new remake.
examples.zh: 大结局烂尾之后，许多观众选择二刷原版，而不是看新版翻拍。

entries.shortAnswer: 「配音」的英文是 dubbing，指用另一种语言替换原声对白；注意配音 dubbing 与字幕 subtitling 不同，前者换声音，后者是文字。
entries.definition: dubbing 指为影视作品录制替换原声的对白，常见搭配有 English dubbing、Chinese dubbing。看剧时「看配音版」说 watch the dubbed version，与「看字幕版」watch with subtitles 区分。

examples.en: I prefer watching foreign shows with Chinese dubbing because I can focus on the visuals.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢看有中文配音的外国剧，因为这样可以专注于画面。

examples.en: The dubbing in that anime was so good that it felt like the characters were originally speaking English.
examples.zh: 那部动画的配音太棒了，感觉角色原本就是说英语的。

entries.shortAnswer: dubbing 的中文意思是「配音」，指用另一种语言的对白替换原声；它和 subtitling 字幕不同，dubbing 换声音，字幕是文字翻译。
entries.definition: dubbing 是名词，指影视作品中用另一种语言重新录制对白的过程或版本。常见搭配：English dubbing、Chinese dubbing、dubbed version。口语中常说 the dubbed version，注意不要与 subtitles 混用。

examples.en: I prefer watching foreign shows with Chinese dubbing because I can focus on the visuals.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢看有中文配音的外国剧，因为这样可以专注于画面。

examples.en: The dubbing in that anime was so good that it felt like the characters were originally speaking English.
examples.zh: 那部动画的配音太棒了，感觉角色原本就是说英语的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「盗版资源」英文是 pirated copy，指未授权传播的影视文件，别跟盗摄混淆。
entries.definition: pirated copy 指非法复制传播的影视文件，可指整部剧或单集；常见搭配 download a pirated copy、a pirated copy of the finale。

examples.en: I couldn't wait for the official release, so I watched a pirated copy of the finale and spoiled the twist.
examples.zh: 我等不及官方上线，就看了大结局的盗版资源，结果把自己剧透了那个反转。

examples.en: The fansub group refused to share a pirated copy and told everyone to support the show legally.
examples.zh: 那个字幕组拒绝分享盗版资源，提醒大家通过正规渠道支持这部剧。

entries.shortAnswer: Pirated copy means 盗版资源 in Chinese: an unauthorized film or TV file, not licensed.
entries.definition: A pirated copy is an illegally reproduced movie or episode file. Watch a pirated copy, spread pirated copies. Neutral but informal.

examples.en: I couldn't wait for the official release, so I watched a pirated copy of the finale and spoiled the twist.
examples.zh: 我等不及官方上线，就看了大结局的盗版资源，结果把自己剧透了那个反转。

examples.en: The fansub group refused to share a pirated copy and told everyone to support the show legally.
examples.zh: 那个字幕组拒绝分享盗版资源，提醒大家通过正规渠道支持这部剧。

entries.shortAnswer: 「演技」的英文是 acting skills，常指演员塑造角色的能力。注意 acting 单独用也可泛指表演，但说某人演技好更常用 acting skills。
entries.definition: acting skills 强调表演技巧，常用搭配：good/poor acting skills、improve one's acting skills。口语也可说 acting 或 performance，但 skills 更突出专业能力。

examples.en: Her acting skills really shine in the series finale, especially during the emotional reunion scene.
examples.zh: 她的演技在大结局里大放异彩，尤其是那场感人的重逢戏。

examples.en: Fans praised his acting skills after the post-credits scene hinted at a possible renewal for season two.
examples.zh: 彩蛋暗示第二季可能续订后，粉丝们纷纷称赞他的演技。

entries.shortAnswer: Acting skills 的中文意思是「演技」，指演员表演角色时的技巧与表现力。它与 performance 不同，acting skills 侧重能力本身，performance 侧重某次演出。
entries.definition: Acting skills 指演员塑造角色的专业能力，常见搭配：strong acting skills、develop acting skills。正式评论和口语都可用，但说某场戏演得好更常说 performance。

examples.en: Her acting skills really shine in the series finale, especially during the emotional reunion scene.
examples.zh: 她的演技在大结局里大放异彩，尤其是那场感人的重逢戏。

examples.en: Fans praised his acting skills after the post-credits scene hinted at a possible renewal for season two.
examples.zh: 彩蛋暗示第二季可能续订后，粉丝们纷纷称赞他的演技。

entries.shortAnswer: 「贴膜」的英文是 apply a screen protector，指给手机屏幕贴保护膜，注意 apply 强调动手贴的动作。
entries.definition: 常用搭配 apply a screen protector on/onto the phone screen。口语也常说 put on a screen protector，apply 偏正式。

examples.en: Before you apply a screen protector, clean the screen with the dust-removal sticker.
examples.zh: 贴膜之前，先用除尘贴把屏幕擦干净。

examples.en: He paid the store ten yuan to apply a screen protector on his new phone.
examples.zh: 他花十块钱让店里给新手机贴了膜。

entries.shortAnswer: apply a screen protector 的中文意思是「贴膜」，即把膜贴到手机屏幕上，强调贴这个动作。
entries.definition: apply a screen protector 用于手机场景，指给屏幕贴保护膜防刮花。常搭配 apply a screen protector to your phone，口语多说 put on。

examples.en: Before you apply a screen protector, clean the screen with the dust-removal sticker.
examples.zh: 贴膜之前，先用除尘贴把屏幕擦干净。

examples.en: He paid the store ten yuan to apply a screen protector on his new phone.
examples.zh: 他花十块钱让店里给新手机贴了膜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「旧手机」最常说的英文是 old phone，指用了很久、不再新的手机；若强调二手买来的，说 second-hand phone。
entries.definition: old phone 指机龄长、成色旧的手机，可指主力旧机或备用机。搭配：trade in my old phone（旧机折抵）、an old phone with a cracked screen（碎屏旧机）。

examples.en: I still use my old phone as a backup, even though its battery is terrible.
examples.zh: 我还在把旧手机当备用机用，虽然它的电池很糟。

examples.en: She traded in her old phone with a cracked screen for a discount.
examples.zh: 她拿碎屏的旧手机去折抵换新，拿到了折扣。

entries.shortAnswer: old phone 的中文意思是「旧手机」，指使用已久、不再新的手机；强调购买来源时用 second-hand phone。
entries.definition: old phone 口语书面都常用，可指用旧的主力机或抽屉里的备用机。搭配：my old phone still works、use an old phone as a backup。

examples.en: I still use my old phone as a backup, even though its battery is terrible.
examples.zh: 我还在把旧手机当备用机用，虽然它的电池很糟。

examples.en: She traded in her old phone with a cracked screen for a discount.
examples.zh: 她拿碎屏的旧手机去折抵换新，拿到了折扣。

entries.shortAnswer: 「换机」的英文是 upgrade to a new phone，指换一部新手机。它强调升级替换，不是换 SIM 卡；旧机回收常说 trade in。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：upgrade to a new phone every two years；口语也可说 get a new phone。换机周期 upgrade cycle 是数码频道高频表达，注意别与换号、换套餐混淆。

examples.en: My old phone is laggy and the battery life is terrible, so I plan to upgrade to a new phone next month.
examples.zh: 我的旧手机很卡顿，续航也很差，所以我打算下个月换机。

examples.en: Many users choose to upgrade to a new phone every two years, which also drives the trade-in market for old devices.
examples.zh: 很多用户选择每两年换机，这也带动了旧机回收市场。

entries.shortAnswer: upgrade to a new phone 的中文意思是「换机」，即换一部新手机。它重点在升级替换，比 get a new phone 更强调从旧机到新机的升级。
entries.definition: 核心义：换一部更新更好的手机。常见搭配：decide to upgrade to a new phone；正式和口语都可用。易错：swap phones 是互换手机，trade in 是旧机折价回收。

examples.en: My old phone is laggy and the battery life is terrible, so I plan to upgrade to a new phone next month.
examples.zh: 我的旧手机很卡顿，续航也很差，所以我打算下个月换机。

examples.en: Many users choose to upgrade to a new phone every two years, which also drives the trade-in market for old devices.
examples.zh: 很多用户选择每两年换机，这也带动了旧机回收市场。

entries.shortAnswer: 「手机壳」的英文是 phone case，也可简称 case。注意它指保护壳，贴膜叫 screen protector。
entries.definition: phone case 是可数名词，指套在手机外起保护或装饰作用的壳子。常见搭配：a clear phone case、a shockproof phone case。注意别与 screen protector（贴膜）混用。

examples.en: I bought a clear phone case so I can still see the color of my new phone.
examples.zh: 我买了一个透明手机壳，这样还能看到新手机的颜色。

examples.en: A shockproof phone case can protect your phone from a cracked screen if you drop it.
examples.zh: 防摔手机壳能在你手机掉落时防止碎屏。

entries.shortAnswer: 「phone case」的中文意思是「手机壳」，指套在手机外起保护或装饰作用的壳子，与贴膜不同。
entries.definition: phone case 是可数名词，日常口语和书面都常用，指手机保护壳。常见搭配：a phone case for iPhone、a clear phone case。注意：它包住机身，不是贴屏幕的 screen protector。

examples.en: I bought a clear phone case so I can still see the color of my new phone.
examples.zh: 我买了一个透明手机壳，这样还能看到新手机的颜色。

examples.en: A shockproof phone case can protect your phone from a cracked screen if you drop it.
examples.zh: 防摔手机壳能在你手机掉落时防止碎屏。

entries.shortAnswer: 「快充」的英文是 fast charging，也可说 fast charge。常见说法：My phone supports fast charging。
entries.definition: fast charging 指提高充电功率、缩短充电时间的充电方式，常搭配 support fast charging、fast charging port。表示快充头则说 fast charger。

examples.en: This phone supports 65W fast charging, so it can reach half battery in about fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 这款手机支持 65W 快充，大约十五分钟就能充到一半电量。

examples.en: If you want faster fast charging, use the original fast charger and cable instead of a cheap third-party one.
examples.zh: 如果想要更快的快充，请使用原装快充头和充电线，别用便宜的第三方配件。

entries.shortAnswer: fast charging 的中文意思是「快充」，也可译作快速充电，与普通充电 regular charging 相对。
entries.definition: fast charging 指以更高功率在更短时间内给设备充电的技术，常见搭配有 support fast charging、fast charging cable。

examples.en: This phone supports 65W fast charging, so it can reach half battery in about fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 这款手机支持 65W 快充，大约十五分钟就能充到一半电量。

examples.en: If you want faster fast charging, use the original fast charger and cable instead of a cheap third-party one.
examples.zh: 如果想要更快的快充，请使用原装快充头和充电线，别用便宜的第三方配件。

entries.shortAnswer: 「原著粉」的英文是 fans of the original book，指先读过原作再追改编影视的观众。
entries.definition: fans of the original book 指先读过原作、再看改编影视的粉丝。作主语时谓语用复数。常与 spoiler、casting 等词一起出现。

examples.en: Fans of the original book were quick to point out that the finale left out a key character.
examples.zh: 原著粉很快指出，大结局删掉了一个关键角色。

examples.en: As fans of the original book, they warned newcomers about spoilers in the post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 作为原著粉，他们提醒新观众注意彩蛋里的剧透。

entries.shortAnswer: 「原著粉」的英文是 fans of the original book，即先看过原著再追改编剧的粉丝。
entries.definition: fans of the original book 指在改编作品播出前就读过原作的粉丝，对改编是否忠于原著格外敏感。语体中性。

examples.en: Fans of the original book were quick to point out that the finale left out a key character.
examples.zh: 原著粉很快指出，大结局删掉了一个关键角色。

examples.en: As fans of the original book, they warned newcomers about spoilers in the post-credits scene.
examples.zh: 作为原著粉，他们提醒新观众注意彩蛋里的剧透。

entries.shortAnswer: 「续航」的英文是 battery life，指设备单次充电后的使用时长，注意是名词短语。
entries.definition: battery life 指设备充满电后能工作的时间，常见搭配有 long battery life、extend battery life。

examples.en: This phone has excellent battery life, lasting almost two days on a single charge.
examples.zh: 这款手机续航非常出色，一次充电几乎能用两天。

examples.en: Turning down the screen brightness can significantly extend your battery life.
examples.zh: 调低屏幕亮度可以显著延长你的续航时间。

entries.shortAnswer: The Chinese word 「续航」 means battery life, the time a device runs on one charge.
entries.definition: battery life is how long a device works on a single charge. Common collocations: long battery life, extend battery life.

examples.en: This phone has excellent battery life, lasting almost two days on a single charge.
examples.zh: 这款手机续航非常出色，一次充电几乎能用两天。

examples.en: Turning down the screen brightness can significantly extend your battery life.
examples.zh: 调低屏幕亮度可以显著延长你的续航时间。

entries.shortAnswer: 「无线充电」的英文是 wireless charging，指手机放上充电板就能补电，不用插线。
entries.definition: wireless charging 是不可数名词短语，常说 support wireless charging、wireless charging pad。别和 fast charging 混用，后者是有线快充。

examples.en: This phone supports wireless charging, so you can just drop it on the pad without plugging in a cable.
examples.zh: 这款手机支持无线充电，放上充电板就行，不用插线。

examples.en: Wireless charging is convenient, but the speed is usually slower than fast charging with a cable.
examples.zh: 无线充电很方便，但速度通常比有线快充慢。

entries.shortAnswer: wireless charging 的中文意思是「无线充电」，指手机放上充电板即可补电，无需插线。
entries.definition: wireless charging 指靠电磁感应为设备供电，常见搭配 support wireless charging、wireless charging pad，不等于有线快充。

examples.en: This phone supports wireless charging, so you can just drop it on the pad without plugging in a cable.
examples.zh: 这款手机支持无线充电，放上充电板就行，不用插线。

examples.en: Wireless charging is convenient, but the speed is usually slower than fast charging with a cable.
examples.zh: 无线充电很方便，但速度通常比有线快充慢。

entries.shortAnswer: 碎屏的英文是 cracked screen，指屏幕有裂纹但通常还能正常显示使用。
entries.definition: cracked screen 是最常用说法，搭配 have a cracked screen、get it fixed、replace it。贴膜预防叫 apply a screen protector。

examples.en: I dropped my phone and now I have a cracked screen, so I need to get it fixed.
examples.zh: 我把手机摔了，现在屏幕碎了，得去修一下。

examples.en: Before buying a used phone, check if it has a cracked screen or any other damage.
examples.zh: 买二手手机之前，要检查屏幕是否碎了或有其他损坏。

entries.shortAnswer: 「碎屏」的英文是 cracked screen，对应屏幕出现裂纹但通常仍可显示的状况。
entries.definition: cracked screen 指屏幕有裂纹，常说 have a cracked screen、fix or replace the cracked screen。口语：My screen is cracked。

examples.en: I dropped my phone and now I have a cracked screen, so I need to get it fixed.
examples.zh: 我把手机摔了，现在屏幕碎了，得去修一下。

examples.en: Before buying a used phone, check if it has a cracked screen or any other damage.
examples.zh: 买二手手机之前，要检查屏幕是否碎了或有其他损坏。

entries.shortAnswer: 「卡顿」的英文是 laggy，形容手机或应用运行不流畅、反应慢。注意 laggy 强调持续性的卡，偶尔一卡用 lag 作动词更自然。
entries.definition: laggy 是形容词，常搭配 get laggy、feel laggy、a bit laggy，多用于手机、游戏、视频通话等场景。名词形式是 lag，指延迟或卡顿；说某台设备一直很卡用 laggy，说此刻突然卡一下则用 it's lagging。

examples.en: My phone gets really laggy after I install too many apps.
examples.zh: 我装太多应用之后，手机变得特别卡顿。

examples.en: The game was so laggy that I couldn't aim properly.
examples.zh: 游戏卡顿得厉害，我根本没法好好瞄准。

entries.shortAnswer: laggy 的中文意思是「卡顿」，指设备或程序运行不流畅、反应迟钝。它强调持续性的迟滞状态，而动词 lag 更偏向某一刻突然卡一下。
entries.definition: laggy 是口语和数码评测中的常用形容词，常见搭配有 get laggy、feel laggy、a laggy phone。多形容手机、游戏、网络或直播画面；正式写作中也可用 sluggish 替代，但 laggy 更强调延迟感。

examples.en: My phone gets really laggy after I install too many apps.
examples.zh: 我装太多应用之后，手机变得特别卡顿。

examples.en: The game was so laggy that I couldn't aim properly.
examples.zh: 游戏卡顿得厉害，我根本没法好好瞄准。

entries.shortAnswer: 「双卡」的英文是 dual SIM，指一部手机可装两张 SIM 卡。注意 dual SIM 作形容词常置于名词前，如 dual SIM phone，口语也常说 dual SIM card。
entries.definition: dual SIM 多指支持两张 SIM 卡的手机或卡槽，常见搭配有 dual SIM phone、dual SIM slot、dual SIM dual standby（双卡双待）。注意它不表示两张卡同时通话，插卡后仍需在设置里选择主卡。

examples.en: This phone is dual SIM, so I keep my work number and personal number in it.
examples.zh: 这部手机是双卡的，所以我把工作号和个人号都放在里面。

examples.en: If you travel a lot, a dual SIM phone saves you from carrying two devices.
examples.zh: 如果你经常出差，双卡手机能让你少带一部设备。

entries.shortAnswer: dual SIM 的中文意思是「双卡」，指一部手机能装两张 SIM 卡。它与 dual standby 不同，后者强调两张卡同时待机，而 dual SIM 只说明有两个卡位。
entries.definition: dual SIM 用作形容词，常见搭配有 dual SIM phone、dual SIM slot、dual SIM dual standby。正式规格表里常见，日常口语也直接说 a dual SIM。注意它指卡位数量，不代表双卡能同时接打电话。

examples.en: This phone is dual SIM, so I keep my work number and personal number in it.
examples.zh: 这部手机是双卡的，所以我把工作号和个人号都放在里面。

examples.en: If you travel a lot, a dual SIM phone saves you from carrying two devices.
examples.zh: 如果你经常出差，双卡手机能让你少带一部设备。

entries.shortAnswer: 「恢复出厂设置」英文是 factory reset，指清除所有数据、还原到初始状态。注意与「重启」restart 不同，它不可撤销，操作前务必备份。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：do/perform a factory reset；常用语境：手机卡顿、准备卖旧机、忘记锁屏密码。区别于格式格式化（format），它还会清除系统设置和账户。

examples.en: My phone was so laggy that I decided to do a factory reset, but I forgot to back up my photos.
examples.zh: 我的手机太卡顿了，于是我决定恢复出厂设置，但我忘了备份照片。

examples.en: Before selling your old phone, you should perform a factory reset to erase all personal data.
examples.zh: 在卖掉旧手机之前，你应该恢复出厂设置，以清除所有个人数据。

entries.shortAnswer: 「factory reset」中文意思是「恢复出厂设置」，把设备恢复到出厂状态，删除所有用户数据。它与「重启（restart）」不同，后者只是重新启动，不会清除数据。
entries.definition: factory reset 可作名词或动词（to factory reset）。常见搭配：perform/do a factory reset。正式场合用 factory data reset，口语常说 wipe the phone。注意恢复后数据不可恢复。

examples.en: My phone was so laggy that I decided to do a factory reset, but I forgot to back up my photos.
examples.zh: 我的手机太卡顿了，于是我决定恢复出厂设置，但我忘了备份照片。

examples.en: Before selling your old phone, you should perform a factory reset to erase all personal data.
examples.zh: 在卖掉旧手机之前，你应该恢复出厂设置，以清除所有个人数据。

entries.shortAnswer: 刷机的英文是 flash the phone，指重装或更换手机系统固件。它不同于越狱 jailbreak，刷机针对的是系统本身，不是绕过应用限制。
entries.definition: 刷机常用搭配：flash the phone with a custom ROM（刷第三方固件）、reflash the phone（重刷）。注意它和越狱 jailbreak 不是一回事，刷机换的是系统，越狱只是获取更高权限；刷机有变砖风险，操作前要备份。

examples.en: I had to flash the phone to get rid of all the bloatware that came with it.
examples.zh: 我不得不刷机，才能去掉手机自带的那些预装软件。

examples.en: Before you flash the phone with a custom ROM, back up all your data.
examples.zh: 在刷第三方固件之前，请先备份所有数据。

entries.shortAnswer: flash the phone 的中文意思是刷机，指给手机重装或更换系统固件。它和 jailbreak（越狱）不同，刷机换的是整个系统，越狱只是解除系统权限限制。
entries.definition: flash the phone 是数码圈常用说法，flash 作动词本义是快速写入，此处指把固件写入手机存储。常见搭配：flash a custom ROM、reflash the phone。刷机可能让手机变砖 brick，操作前务必备份数据。

examples.en: I had to flash the phone to get rid of all the bloatware that came with it.
examples.zh: 我不得不刷机，才能去掉手机自带的那些预装软件。

examples.en: Before you flash the phone with a custom ROM, back up all your data.
examples.zh: 在刷第三方固件之前，请先备份所有数据。

entries.shortAnswer: 「内存」在手机数码语境中常译为 phone memory，指手机内部存储空间，注意别与运行内存混淆。
entries.definition: phone memory 指手机内部存储空间，用于存放照片、应用等。常见搭配：free up phone memory、run out of phone memory。注意：运行内存英语常说 RAM。

examples.en: My phone memory is almost full, so I need to delete some old videos.
examples.zh: 我的手机内存快满了，所以需要删除一些旧视频。

examples.en: Before selling your old phone, wipe the phone memory to protect your privacy.
examples.zh: 在卖掉旧手机之前，请抹掉手机内存以保护隐私。

entries.shortAnswer: phone memory 的中文意思是「内存」，指手机内部存储空间，不是运行内存。
entries.definition: phone memory 即手机内部存储空间，用于存放应用、照片和文件。常见搭配：free up phone memory、run out of phone memory。注意与 RAM 区分。

examples.en: My phone memory is almost full, so I need to delete some old videos.
examples.zh: 我的手机内存快满了，所以需要删除一些旧视频。

examples.en: Before selling your old phone, wipe the phone memory to protect your privacy.
examples.zh: 在卖掉旧手机之前，请抹掉手机内存以保护隐私。

entries.shortAnswer: 「系统更新」的英文是 system update，指为修复漏洞或增加功能而升级手机操作系统。注意别写成 system upgrade，后者更强调硬件或大版本升级。
entries.definition: system update 是可数名词，常说 install / download / push out a system update。手机里那条提示就是 a system update is available，安装后可修复漏洞、提升续航，但有时也会带来卡顿。

examples.en: My phone keeps prompting me to install a system update, but I'm worried it will slow things down.
examples.zh: 我的手机一直提示我安装系统更新，但我担心更新后会更卡顿。

examples.en: After the system update, the battery life improved and the laggy interface finally felt smooth.
examples.zh: 系统更新之后，续航变好了，原本卡顿的界面终于变得流畅。

entries.shortAnswer: system update 的中文意思是「系统更新」，指手机或电脑操作系统发布的升级包。它偏指软件补丁和小版本迭代，与强调硬件升级的 upgrade 不同。
entries.definition: system update 指操作系统官方推送的更新，常见搭配 install / roll out a system update。日常口语就说 update，正式场合用全称；注意它不等于刷机 flash the phone 或越狱 jailbreak。

examples.en: My phone keeps prompting me to install a system update, but I'm worried it will slow things down.
examples.zh: 我的手机一直提示我安装系统更新，但我担心更新后会更卡顿。

examples.en: After the system update, the battery life improved and the laggy interface finally felt smooth.
examples.zh: 系统更新之后，续航变好了，原本卡顿的界面终于变得流畅。

entries.shortAnswer: 「存储空间」英文是 storage space，指设备保存数据的容量，口语常简说 storage。
entries.definition: 指设备或云端存放照片、应用、系统文件的容量，常搭配 run out of、free up，注意与 memory 区分。

examples.en: My phone keeps warning me that I'm running out of storage space, so I need to delete some old videos.
examples.zh: 我的手机一直提醒我存储空间不足，所以我需要删除一些旧视频。

examples.en: Before flashing the phone, make sure you back up all important data because the process will wipe your internal storage space.
examples.zh: 在刷机之前，请确保备份所有重要数据，因为该过程会清空你的内置存储空间。

entries.shortAnswer: 「storage space」意思是「存储空间」，即设备保存数据的容量，不同于 memory。
entries.definition: The capacity a device uses to store files, apps and system data; collocates with run out of, free up.

examples.en: My phone keeps warning me that I'm running out of storage space, so I need to delete some old videos.
examples.zh: 我的手机一直提醒我存储空间不足，所以我需要删除一些旧视频。

examples.en: Before flashing the phone, make sure you back up all important data because the process will wipe your internal storage space.
examples.zh: 在刷机之前，请确保备份所有重要数据，因为该过程会清空你的内置存储空间。

entries.shortAnswer: 「黑屏」的英文是 black screen，指屏幕完全不亮或不显示内容。注意别和 cracked screen（碎屏）混用。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：my phone has a black screen（我手机黑屏了）、the screen went black（屏幕变黑了）。若只是屏幕碎了但还能亮，应说 cracked screen，不能说 black screen。

examples.en: After I dropped my phone, it showed a black screen and wouldn't turn on.
examples.zh: 我手机摔了之后一直黑屏，开不了机。

examples.en: The repair shop said the black screen was caused by a loose display cable, not a cracked screen.
examples.zh: 维修店说黑屏是显示排线松动造成的，不是碎屏。

entries.shortAnswer: "black screen" 的中文意思是「黑屏」，指设备屏幕完全不亮或没有画面。它强调显示内容消失，不能和 cracked screen 互换。
entries.definition: 核心义：屏幕黑掉、无画面，常见于手机数码语境，如 a black screen after the update（更新后黑屏）。口语里也可说 the screen went black。

examples.en: After I dropped my phone, it showed a black screen and wouldn't turn on.
examples.zh: 我手机摔了之后一直黑屏，开不了机。

examples.en: The repair shop said the black screen was caused by a loose display cable, not a cracked screen.
examples.zh: 维修店说黑屏是显示排线松动造成的，不是碎屏。

entries.shortAnswer: “越狱”的英文是 jailbreak，专指绕过苹果手机系统限制来安装未上架应用。
entries.definition: jailbreak 可作动词或名词，常见搭配有 jailbreak an iPhone、jailbroken device。它是苹果系统独有说法，安卓平台的类似操作叫 root。

examples.en: He decided to jailbreak his old iPhone so he could install apps from outside the official store.
examples.zh: 他决定越狱他的旧苹果手机，以便安装官方商店以外的应用。

examples.en: Jailbreaking your device may void the warranty and expose it to security risks.
examples.zh: 越狱你的设备可能会使保修失效，并使其面临安全风险。

entries.shortAnswer: “jailbreak”的中文意思是“越狱”，指绕过苹果系统限制来安装非官方应用，专用于苹果设备。
entries.definition: jailbreak 可作动词或名词，常见搭配有 jailbreak an iPhone、jailbreak tool。此说法专用于苹果设备，安卓平台对应操作叫 root，不要混用。

examples.en: He decided to jailbreak his old iPhone so he could install apps from outside the official store.
examples.zh: 他决定越狱他的旧苹果手机，以便安装官方商店以外的应用。

examples.en: Jailbreaking your device may void the warranty and expose it to security risks.
examples.zh: 越狱你的设备可能会使保修失效，并使其面临安全风险。

entries.shortAnswer: 旧机回收的英文是 phone trade-in，指用旧手机折价换购新机。注意 phone trade-in 是名词短语，动词形式常用 trade in a phone，不要与 recycle 混用。
entries.definition: phone trade-in 特指将旧手机交给商家折价抵扣新机费用，常见搭配有 offer a phone trade-in、trade-in value。与 recycle 不同，trade-in 强调抵扣换新，常见于手机数码换机场景。

examples.en: Many carriers offer a phone trade-in program that lets you lower the cost of a new device.
examples.zh: 许多运营商提供旧机回收计划，让你可以降低购买新设备的费用。

examples.en: Before you do a phone trade-in, back up your data and check the trade-in value online.
examples.zh: 在进行旧机回收之前，请备份数据并在线查询折价金额。

entries.shortAnswer: phone trade-in 的中文意思是旧机回收，指用旧手机折价换新机。它强调折价抵扣，不同于单纯回收废弃手机的 recycle 或回收再生。
entries.definition: phone trade-in 指购买新手机时，将旧手机交给商家折价抵扣部分价款。常见搭配有 offer a phone trade-in、trade-in value、trade in your old phone。口语和正式场合均可用，注意动词形式是 trade in。

examples.en: Many carriers offer a phone trade-in program that lets you lower the cost of a new device.
examples.zh: 许多运营商提供旧机回收计划，让你可以降低购买新设备的费用。

examples.en: Before you do a phone trade-in, back up your data and check the trade-in value online.
examples.zh: 在进行旧机回收之前，请备份数据并在线查询折价金额。

entries.shortAnswer: 「备份」英文是 back up data，动词短语表动作；名词 backup 指备份文件。
entries.definition: back up data 指把数据复制到另一介质防丢失，常用搭配 cloud backup、full backup、back up photos。

examples.en: Before flashing the phone, I always back up data to the cloud to avoid losing photos and contacts.
examples.zh: 刷机前，我总是把数据备份到云端，以免丢失照片和联系人。

examples.en: You should back up data regularly, especially when your screen is cracked and you might replace the phone soon.
examples.zh: 你应该定期备份数据，尤其是屏幕碎了、可能很快要换机的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: Back up data means 备份 in Chinese: copy data to prevent loss.
entries.definition: Back up data is a verb phrase; the noun is backup. Common: cloud backup, full backup, back up files.

examples.en: Before flashing the phone, I always back up data to the cloud to avoid losing photos and contacts.
examples.zh: 刷机前，我总是把数据备份到云端，以免丢失照片和联系人。

examples.en: You should back up data regularly, especially when your screen is cracked and you might replace the phone soon.
examples.zh: 你应该定期备份数据，尤其是屏幕碎了、可能很快要换机的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: 「二手机」的英文是 used phone，指别人用过再转卖的手机，口语里也常说 second-hand phone。
entries.definition: used phone 泛指非全新手机，涵盖成色、续航、碎屏等状况，常见于闲置回收与以旧换新。

examples.en: I bought a used phone online and the seller said the battery life was still great.
examples.zh: 我在网上买了一部二手机，卖家说续航还很好。

examples.en: Before selling your used phone, check for a cracked screen and test fast charging.
examples.zh: 卖二手机之前，先检查有没有碎屏，再测一下快充。

entries.shortAnswer: used phone 的中文意思是「二手机」，即别人用过再转卖的手机，比 refurbished phone 范围更宽。
entries.definition: A used phone is any non-new handset sold second-hand; check condition, battery life, cracked screen, and dual SIM support.

examples.en: I bought a used phone online and the seller said the battery life was still great.
examples.zh: 我在网上买了一部二手机，卖家说续航还很好。

examples.en: Before selling your used phone, check for a cracked screen and test fast charging.
examples.zh: 卖二手机之前，先检查有没有碎屏，再测一下快充。

entries.shortAnswer: 组装机的英文是 refurbished phone，但严格说指官方翻新机。注意，中文“组装机”常指自己拼装的电脑或手机，英文是 custom-built PC 或 DIY phone。
entries.definition: refurbished phone 指经过官方或第三方检测、维修并重新销售的翻新手机，通常有保修。而中文“组装机”若指个人拼装，则用 custom-built 或 self-assembled。

examples.en: I bought a refurbished phone to save money, but it still has a great battery life and supports fast charging.
examples.zh: 我买了一台组装机来省钱，但它依然有很好的续航并支持快充。

examples.en: If your cracked screen is too expensive to fix, consider trading in your old device for a refurbished phone.
examples.zh: 如果你的碎屏维修太贵，可以考虑用旧机折价换一台组装机。

entries.shortAnswer: refurbished phone 的中文意思是组装机，但更准确是官方翻新机。它区别于二手手机 used phone，通常经过检测并带保修。
entries.definition: refurbished phone 指由制造商或零售商翻新后出售的手机，常搭配 buy a refurbished phone、certified refurbished。口语中也可说 refurbed phone，注意与 used 和 second-hand 区分。

examples.en: I bought a refurbished phone to save money, but it still has a great battery life and supports fast charging.
examples.zh: 我买了一台组装机来省钱，但它依然有很好的续航并支持快充。

examples.en: If your cracked screen is too expensive to fix, consider trading in your old device for a refurbished phone.
examples.zh: 如果你的碎屏维修太贵，可以考虑用旧机折价换一台组装机。

entries.shortAnswer: 「降级」在手机数码中指 downgrade the system，把手机系统回退到旧版本。
entries.definition: downgrade the system 指把手机系统回退到较早版本，常用于解决新系统卡顿、耗电等问题。

examples.en: After the update my phone became laggy and the battery drained fast, so I decided to downgrade the system.
examples.zh: 更新后我的手机变得卡顿且耗电快，所以我决定降级系统。

examples.en: You can't downgrade the system without unlocking the bootloader, and doing so may void your warranty.
examples.zh: 不解锁引导程序就无法降级系统，而且这样做可能会失去保修。

entries.shortAnswer: downgrade the system means「降级」: rolling a phone's OS back to an older version.
entries.definition: downgrade the system means installing an older OS version on a phone, often to fix lag or battery drain.

examples.en: After the update my phone became laggy and the battery drained fast, so I decided to downgrade the system.
examples.zh: 更新后我的手机变得卡顿且耗电快，所以我决定降级系统。

examples.en: You can't downgrade the system without unlocking the bootloader, and doing so may void your warranty.
examples.zh: 不解锁引导程序就无法降级系统，而且这样做可能会失去保修。

entries.shortAnswer: 云存储的英文是 cloud storage，指通过互联网把文件存在远程服务器上。注意别与 cloud computing 混用，后者指算力服务。
entries.definition: cloud storage 是标准说法，常见搭配有 use cloud storage、cloud storage service、free cloud storage。口语也可说 the cloud，但 the cloud 更宽泛，可泛指云计算服务。

examples.en: My phone is running out of space, so I moved all my photos to cloud storage.
examples.zh: 我手机空间快满了，所以把照片都转存到了云存储。

examples.en: This cloud storage service gives you free space, but you have to pay for more.
examples.zh: 这个云存储服务提供免费空间，但扩容需要付费。

entries.shortAnswer: cloud storage 的中文意思是云存储，指把照片、文件等数据存放在远程服务器上。它强调存文件，而 cloud computing 强调算力。
entries.definition: cloud storage 指通过网络存取的远程存储服务，常见搭配有 cloud storage service、cloud storage space、use cloud storage。日常口语常直接说 the cloud，正式写作多用完整形式。

examples.en: My phone is running out of space, so I moved all my photos to cloud storage.
examples.zh: 我手机空间快满了，所以把照片都转存到了云存储。

examples.en: This cloud storage service gives you free space, but you have to pay for more.
examples.zh: 这个云存储服务提供免费空间，但扩容需要付费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「水货」英文即 gray-market phone，指非官方渠道进口的正品手机，真机但无官方保修，非假货。
entries.definition: gray-market phone 指未经授权渠道入市的正品手机，质量同于行货，但无官方保修，别与假货混淆。

examples.en: He bought a gray-market phone to save money, but later found it had no official warranty.
examples.zh: 他为了省钱买了一部水货手机，后来发现它没有官方保修。

examples.en: Many gray-market phones are genuine, so don't confuse them with counterfeit ones.
examples.zh: 很多水货手机是正品，别把它们和假货混为一谈。

entries.shortAnswer: 「水货」in English is gray-market phone: a genuine phone sold via unofficial channels, not a fake.
entries.definition: A gray-market phone is a genuine imported handset sold outside official channels, so it lacks official warranty.

examples.en: He bought a gray-market phone to save money, but later found it had no official warranty.
examples.zh: 他为了省钱买了一部水货手机，后来发现它没有官方保修。

examples.en: Many gray-market phones are genuine, so don't confuse them with counterfeit ones.
examples.zh: 很多水货手机是正品，别把它们和假货混为一谈。

entries.shortAnswer: 「备菜」英文说 prep the ingredients，指开火前把食材洗切配好。
entries.definition: prep the ingredients 指下锅前把食材洗净、切好、量齐，prep 是 prepare 的缩略，强调准备动作而非菜名。

examples.en: Before you turn on the stove, prep the ingredients: dice the carrots, slice the pork, and mince the garlic.
examples.zh: 开火之前先备菜：胡萝卜切丁，猪肉切片，大蒜剁末。

examples.en: I always prep the ingredients the night before so that stir-frying takes only ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我总在前一晚备好菜，这样真正下锅爆炒只要十分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: prep the ingredients 就是中文「备菜」，做菜前把食材洗好切好。
entries.definition: prep the ingredients means preparing and cutting ingredients before cooking; prep is short for prepare, and no heat is involved.

examples.en: Before you turn on the stove, prep the ingredients: dice the carrots, slice the pork, and mince the garlic.
examples.zh: 开火之前先备菜：胡萝卜切丁，猪肉切片，大蒜剁末。

examples.en: I always prep the ingredients the night before so that stir-frying takes only ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我总在前一晚备好菜，这样真正下锅爆炒只要十分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: 「腌制」的英文是 marinate，指用调味汁浸泡食材使其入味。注意 marinate 强调浸泡在液体腌料中，干抹盐或香料的方法一般说 season 或 cure。
entries.definition: marinate 常与 in 连用，如 marinate the chicken in soy sauce（用生抽腌鸡肉）。时间可用 for + 时长或 overnight。肉类、海鲜、豆腐都常用；蔬菜短时间腌入味也可用。名词形式是 marinade，指腌料本身。

examples.en: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, rice wine, and a little cornstarch for twenty minutes before stir-frying.
examples.zh: 炒之前把鸡肉用生抽、料酒和少许淀粉腌制二十分钟。

examples.en: The beef needs to marinate overnight so the flavors can soak all the way through.
examples.zh: 牛肉需要腌制一整夜，味道才能完全渗进去。

entries.shortAnswer: marinate 的中文意思是「腌制」，指把食材泡在调味汁里使其入味。它与 pickle（用醋或盐水腌渍保存）不同，marinate 主要目的是增味和嫩化，不强调长期保存。
entries.definition: marinate 作动词，常用搭配 marinate sth in sth，如 marinate the beef in wine。既可指中式用生抽、料酒、淀粉上浆前的腌制，也可指西式用油醋香草浸泡。名词 marinade 指腌料；过去分词 marinated 常作形容词。

examples.en: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, rice wine, and a little cornstarch for twenty minutes before stir-frying.
examples.zh: 炒之前把鸡肉用生抽、料酒和少许淀粉腌制二十分钟。

examples.en: The beef needs to marinate overnight so the flavors can soak all the way through.
examples.zh: 牛肉需要腌制一整夜，味道才能完全渗进去。

entries.shortAnswer: 美版的英文是 US version，指在美国市场销售的手机版本。注意它与国行 China version、水货 gray-market 版本在保修和网络频段上不同。
entries.definition: US version 常用于手机数码语境，如买美版 iPhone、美版无锁机。选购时要留意美版可能不支持中国双卡 dual SIM 与部分 5G 频段，保修也通常只在美国有效，和国行 China version 有别。

examples.en: I bought the US version of this phone, but it only supports one physical SIM, so I can't use dual SIM here.
examples.zh: 我买了这款手机的美版，但它只支持一个实体卡槽，所以在这里用不了双卡。

examples.en: The US version often lacks some 5G bands used in China, and its warranty doesn't cover repairs here.
examples.zh: 美版往往缺少中国使用的部分 5G 频段，而且它的保修不覆盖这里的维修。

entries.shortAnswer: US version 的中文意思是美版，即在美国市场销售的版本。它与国行 China version 的关键区别在于网络频段、双卡支持和保修地区不同。
entries.definition: US version 指面向美国发售的机型，常见于 iPhone、三星等。美版常为单卡或 eSIM，频段按美国运营商定制；刷机 flash the phone 或越狱 jailbreak 后仍可能缺中国频段，购买前需确认是否无锁。

examples.en: I bought the US version of this phone, but it only supports one physical SIM, so I can't use dual SIM here.
examples.zh: 我买了这款手机的美版，但它只支持一个实体卡槽，所以在这里用不了双卡。

examples.en: The US version often lacks some 5G bands used in China, and its warranty doesn't cover repairs here.
examples.zh: 美版往往缺少中国使用的部分 5G 频段，而且它的保修不覆盖这里的维修。

entries.shortAnswer: 国行英文是 mainland China version，指在中国大陆正规销售的版本。
entries.definition: 国行即 mainland China version，指在中国大陆正规销售、有入网许可和全国联保的版本，与港版、美版等水货相对。

examples.en: I always buy the mainland China version because it has dual SIM and official warranty.
examples.zh: 我总是买国行，因为它支持双卡和官方保修。

examples.en: The mainland China version supports faster charging than the global variant.
examples.zh: 国行支持比国际版更快的充电速度。

entries.shortAnswer: Mainland China version 即国行，指在中国大陆正式发售的版本。
entries.definition: Mainland China version (国行) refers to a device officially sold in mainland China with warranty and network license.

examples.en: I always buy the mainland China version because it has dual SIM and official warranty.
examples.zh: 我总是买国行，因为它支持双卡和官方保修。

examples.en: The mainland China version supports faster charging than the global variant.
examples.zh: 国行支持比国际版更快的充电速度。

entries.shortAnswer: 焯水英文常译作 blanch，指把食材放入沸水短时间煮后捞出，用于去腥、定型或预熟。
entries.definition: blanch 作动词，指把食材放入沸水短时间煮后捞出；常搭配 blanch the meat、blanch the vegetables，中餐常加料酒姜片去腥。

examples.en: Blanch the pork bones with ginger and cooking wine to remove the blood foam before making the broth.
examples.zh: 熬高汤前，把猪骨加姜片和料酒焯水，去掉血沫。

examples.en: For a crisp texture, blanch the green beans quickly and then shock them in ice water.
examples.zh: 为了口感爽脆，把四季豆快速焯水，然后浸入冰水。

entries.shortAnswer: Blanch means 焯水：to boil food briefly, then drain or cool it, often to remove smells or precook.
entries.definition: To blanch is to cook food briefly in boiling water, often then cooling it in ice water. 常见搭配 blanch the beans、blanch the bones。

examples.en: Blanch the pork bones with ginger and cooking wine to remove the blood foam before making the broth.
examples.zh: 熬高汤前，把猪骨加姜片和料酒焯水，去掉血沫。

examples.en: For a crisp texture, blanch the green beans quickly and then shock them in ice water.
examples.zh: 为了口感爽脆，把四季豆快速焯水，然后浸入冰水。

entries.shortAnswer: 上浆的英文是 coat with starch，指用薄淀粉浆抓匀肉片锁水，是嫩肉关键。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：coat the beef with starch（给牛肉上浆）。易错点：上浆用薄淀粉浆，不同于挂糊的厚面糊。

examples.en: To keep the pork slices tender, coat them with starch and let them rest for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 为了让肉片嫩滑，给它们上浆并静置十分钟。

examples.en: Many stir-fry recipes tell you to coat the beef with starch before quickly searing it in a hot wok.
examples.zh: 许多炒菜食谱会要求先把牛肉上浆，再放入热锅中快速滑炒。

entries.shortAnswer: Coat with starch means 上浆, coating meat in a thin starch slurry to keep it tender.
entries.definition: Common collocation: coat the chicken with starch before stir-frying. Not the same as batter, a thick coating for deep-frying.

examples.en: To keep the pork slices tender, coat them with starch and let them rest for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 为了让肉片嫩滑，给它们上浆并静置十分钟。

examples.en: Many stir-fry recipes tell you to coat the beef with starch before quickly searing it in a hot wok.
examples.zh: 许多炒菜食谱会要求先把牛肉上浆，再放入热锅中快速滑炒。

entries.shortAnswer: 「勾芡」的英文是 thicken the sauce，指在菜肴快出锅前淋入水淀粉使汤汁变浓。不要把「勾芡」直译成 add starch，那只是加淀粉，不一定有增稠效果。
entries.definition: 勾芡常与「出锅前」连用，英文多说 thicken the sauce at the end，也可用 thicken the sauce with a cornstarch slurry。易错点：cornstarch 是玉米淀粉，勾芡用水淀粉调成 slurry，不是直接撒干粉。

examples.en: After the chicken is cooked through, thicken the sauce with a cornstarch slurry and toss to coat.
examples.zh: 鸡肉熟透后，用水淀粉勾芡，然后翻拌均匀裹上汤汁。

examples.en: If you want a glossier finish, take the wok off the heat before you thicken the sauce.
examples.zh: 如果你想要更亮泽的成品，勾芡前先把炒锅端离火口。

entries.shortAnswer: thicken the sauce 的中文是「勾芡」，指把水淀粉淋入锅中让汤汁变浓稠。它与 reduce the sauce 不同：reduce 靠蒸发收汁，thicken 靠淀粉增稠。
entries.definition: thicken the sauce 是烹饪常用表达，正式菜谱和日常口语都可用。常见搭配：thicken the sauce with cornstarch / a slurry；注意不能只说 thicken，宾语 sauce 通常要出现。

examples.en: After the chicken is cooked through, thicken the sauce with a cornstarch slurry and toss to coat.
examples.zh: 鸡肉熟透后，用水淀粉勾芡，然后翻拌均匀裹上汤汁。

examples.en: If you want a glossier finish, take the wok off the heat before you thicken the sauce.
examples.zh: 如果你想要更亮泽的成品，勾芡前先把炒锅端离火口。

entries.shortAnswer: 「炖」的英文是 simmer，指用小火慢煮使食材入味。注意与 boil（大火沸腾）和 stew（更浓、更久的炖菜）区分，收汁阶段常说 reduce the sauce。
entries.definition: 炖指用中小火长时间加热，让食材在汤汁中变软入味。常见搭配：simmer the soup（炖汤）、simmer over low heat（小火炖）。与 boil 不同，simmer 是微沸状态，不翻滚；与 stew 相比，simmer 更强调火候，stew 更强调菜式。

examples.en: Let the tomato sauce simmer over low heat for twenty minutes to reduce the sauce.
examples.zh: 让番茄酱用小火炖二十分钟，以便收汁。

examples.en: After you blanch the pork ribs, add them to the stock and simmer until tender.
examples.zh: 排骨焯水后放入高汤中炖至软烂。

entries.shortAnswer: simmer 的中文意思是「炖」，指用小火慢煮使食材入味。关键在于它表示微沸状态，不同于大火 boil（煮沸），也不同于慢炖菜式 stew。
entries.definition: simmer 作动词，指液体在略低于沸点下微微冒泡，常用于烹饪。搭配：simmer the sauce（炖酱汁）、simmer for 20 minutes（炖二十分钟）。正式菜谱和日常口语都常用；注意别与 boil 混用，boil 是大火沸腾。

examples.en: Let the tomato sauce simmer over low heat for twenty minutes to reduce the sauce.
examples.zh: 让番茄酱用小火炖二十分钟，以便收汁。

examples.en: After you blanch the pork ribs, add them to the stock and simmer until tender.
examples.zh: 排骨焯水后放入高汤中炖至软烂。

entries.shortAnswer: 「蒸」的英文是 steam，指利用水蒸气把食物加热做熟。注意 steam 作动词既可表示蒸食物，也可表示冒热气，别和 boil（水煮）混淆。
entries.definition: 作动词时常用 steam the fish／steamed buns（蒸鱼、包子），也可说 cook sth by steaming。与 boil 不同：boil 是浸在水里煮，steam 是隔水用蒸汽加热，所以蒸屉、蒸锅里的食物并不泡在水里。

examples.en: Steam the fish for about eight minutes, then pour over some hot oil and soy sauce.
examples.zh: 把鱼蒸大约八分钟，然后淋上热油和生抽。

examples.en: She prefers steamed vegetables because they keep more of their nutrients.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢蒸蔬菜，因为这样能保留更多营养。

entries.shortAnswer: steam 的中文意思是「蒸」，指用水蒸气把食物加热做熟。它还可表示「冒热气」，而 boil 强调的是放在水里煮，两者加热方式不同。
entries.definition: steam 作动词是蒸、隔水蒸，如 steam vegetables、steamed fish；作名词是水蒸气。口语里 Steamed buns 就是馒头、包子。注意别把它和 boil（水煮）、stew（炖）混用，蒸的食物不直接浸在水里。

examples.en: Steam the fish for about eight minutes, then pour over some hot oil and soy sauce.
examples.zh: 把鱼蒸大约八分钟，然后淋上热油和生抽。

examples.en: She prefers steamed vegetables because they keep more of their nutrients.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢蒸蔬菜，因为这样能保留更多营养。

entries.shortAnswer: 焖的英文是 braise，指加少量液体、盖紧锅盖用小火长时间加热。注意 braise 偏西餐炖煮，中餐的焖更强调密封与火候，常见搭配有 braised pork 和 braised beef。
entries.definition: braise 作动词，指先把食材煎炒上色，再加少量高汤或水，盖盖小火慢煮至酥软。常与焖、烧、烩等中式技法对应；与 stew 不同，braise 液体更少、更强调密封。

examples.en: I like to braise the pork belly with soy sauce and rock sugar until it's tender and glossy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢用生抽和冰糖焖五花肉，直到肉质酥软、色泽油亮。

examples.en: Braising the beef in a covered pot for two hours makes it incredibly tender.
examples.zh: 把牛肉放在加盖的锅里焖两个小时，会变得非常软烂。

entries.shortAnswer: braise 的中文意思是焖，即用少量液体盖盖小火慢煮。与 stew 相比，braise 通常液体更少、更常先煎上色，成品更浓郁。
entries.definition: braise 是烹饪动词，指在密封锅中加少量液体小火慢煮，常用于肉类和根茎蔬菜。常见搭配 braised beef、braised pork belly；比 stew 更强调密封与少液体。

examples.en: I like to braise the pork belly with soy sauce and rock sugar until it's tender and glossy.
examples.zh: 我喜欢用生抽和冰糖焖五花肉，直到肉质酥软、色泽油亮。

examples.en: Braising the beef in a covered pot for two hours makes it incredibly tender.
examples.zh: 把牛肉放在加盖的锅里焖两个小时，会变得非常软烂。

entries.shortAnswer: 「炝锅」的英文是 sizzle aromatics，指热油爆香葱姜蒜给菜打底。注意它说的是香味前奏，不是把食材炒熟。
entries.definition: 炝锅是中式热炒的第一步：油烧热后下葱姜蒜或干辣椒，快速爆出香味再下主料。英文说 sizzle the aromatics 或 sauté aromatics first，强调油温与镬气，别理解成普通炒制。

examples.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, then sizzle aromatics with scallion and garlic before adding the pork.
examples.zh: 把锅烧到冒烟，先下葱蒜炝锅，再放猪肉。

examples.en: She likes to sizzle aromatics in a little oil to wake up the kitchen before stir-frying.
examples.zh: 她喜欢先用一点油炝锅，让厨房香气起来再开炒。

entries.shortAnswer: Sizzle aromatics 的中文是「炝锅」，指用热油快速爆香葱姜蒜等。它侧重爆出香味的起手步骤，不等于把食材炒熟。
entries.definition: sizzle aromatics 是中式烹饪里热油爆香葱姜蒜、干辣椒的步骤，常见搭配 sizzle the aromatics first、sizzle aromatics in oil。口语也常说 sauté aromatics；它偏动作起手，不是一道独立菜。

examples.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, then sizzle aromatics with scallion and garlic before adding the pork.
examples.zh: 把锅烧到冒烟，先下葱蒜炝锅，再放猪肉。

examples.en: She likes to sizzle aromatics in a little oil to wake up the kitchen before stir-frying.
examples.zh: 她喜欢先用一点油炝锅，让厨房香气起来再开炒。

entries.shortAnswer: 「煎」的英文是 pan-fry，指用少量油在平底锅里中火加热食物，使其表面金黄酥脆。
entries.definition: pan-fry 指在平底锅中加少量油，以中火加热食物，使表面焦香、内部熟透，例如煎蛋、煎饺、煎鱼。

examples.en: Pan-fry the dumplings in a little oil until the bottoms are golden and crisp.
examples.zh: 用少量油把饺子煎到底部金黄酥脆。

examples.en: She pan-fried the salmon for three minutes on each side and served it with lemon.
examples.zh: 她把三文鱼每面各煎三分钟，然后配上柠檬端上桌。

entries.shortAnswer: pan-fry means 「煎」 in Chinese: to cook food in a shallow pan with a little oil over medium heat.
entries.definition: pan-fry means to cook food in a shallow pan with a little oil over medium heat, turning it until both sides are golden and cooked through.

examples.en: Pan-fry the dumplings in a little oil until the bottoms are golden and crisp.
examples.zh: 用少量油把饺子煎到底部金黄酥脆。

examples.en: She pan-fried the salmon for three minutes on each side and served it with lemon.
examples.zh: 她把三文鱼每面各煎三分钟，然后配上柠檬端上桌。

entries.shortAnswer: 「爆炒」的英文是 stir-fry on high heat，指大火、短时间、快速翻动把食材炒熟。
entries.definition: 爆炒强调大火、油热、时间短、动作快，锅要烧到冒烟再下料。常用搭配有 stir-fry the beef on high heat。易错点：只说 stir-fry 可能指中火慢炒，缺「大火」这一核心。

examples.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, then stir-fry the beef on high heat for about a minute.
examples.zh: 把锅烧到冒烟，然后大火爆炒牛肉大约一分钟。

examples.en: If you stir-fry the vegetables on high heat, they will stay crisp and bright green.
examples.zh: 如果你大火爆炒这些蔬菜，它们会保持脆嫩、颜色翠绿。

entries.shortAnswer: stir-fry on high heat 的中文意思是「爆炒」，指用猛火快速翻炒食材，比一般 stir-fry 更强调火力大。
entries.definition: stir-fry on high heat 是烹饪动词短语，突出高温快炒，常在食谱里出现。搭配有 stir-fry the shrimp on high heat。注意它不等于 deep-fry 油炸或 stew 炖煮。

examples.en: Heat the wok until it smokes, then stir-fry the beef on high heat for about a minute.
examples.zh: 把锅烧到冒烟，然后大火爆炒牛肉大约一分钟。

examples.en: If you stir-fry the vegetables on high heat, they will stay crisp and bright green.
examples.zh: 如果你大火爆炒这些蔬菜，它们会保持脆嫩、颜色翠绿。

entries.shortAnswer: 「颠勺」的英文是 toss the wok，指手腕发力让锅中食材抛起翻面。注意它强调锅体运动，不是用锅铲翻搅，且专业厨师常用此技。
entries.definition: toss the wok 描述通过颠动炒锅使食材腾空翻转，均匀受热并裹上酱汁。常见搭配：toss the wok over high heat。易错点：别与 stir-fry 混淆，后者只指用锅铲翻炒。

examples.en: The chef tossed the wok over high heat, sending the vegetables leaping into the air.
examples.zh: 厨师高温颠勺，把蔬菜抛向空中。

examples.en: Learning to toss the wok takes practice, but it helps coat every piece with sauce evenly.
examples.zh: 学颠勺需要练习，但它能让每块食材均匀裹上酱汁。

entries.shortAnswer: 「toss the wok」的中文意思是「颠勺」，即通过手腕动作让锅中食材抛起翻面。它特指锅体运动，不同于用锅铲翻拌的 stir-fry。
entries.definition: toss the wok 意为颠动炒锅使食材腾空，常见于专业厨房和中餐教学。搭配：toss the wok over high heat。注意：口语中也可说 wok tossing，但别与用铲子翻动的 stir-fry 混用。

examples.en: The chef tossed the wok over high heat, sending the vegetables leaping into the air.
examples.zh: 厨师高温颠勺，把蔬菜抛向空中。

examples.en: Learning to toss the wok takes practice, but it helps coat every piece with sauce evenly.
examples.zh: 学颠勺需要练习，但它能让每块食材均匀裹上酱汁。

entries.shortAnswer: 「刀工」的英文是 knife skills，指切菜时刀法熟练、食材形状均匀。注意它通常用复数，说刀工好常搭配 good knife skills。
entries.definition: knife skills 指切配食材的刀法功底，如切丁 dice、切片 slice、切丝 julienne、剁馅 mince。说某人刀工好常用 have good knife skills，不用 knife skill。

examples.en: Good knife skills make it easier to dice onions evenly for the stir-fry.
examples.zh: 好的刀工让你更容易把洋葱切成均匀的丁，用来炒菜。

examples.en: The chef's knife skills are so impressive that he can julienne carrots in seconds.
examples.zh: 这位厨师的刀工非常了得，几秒钟就能把胡萝卜切成细丝。

entries.shortAnswer: Knife skills 的中文意思是「刀工」，即切配食材的刀法功底。它强调切丁、切片、切丝等技巧，比泛指用刀的 knife work 更具体。
entries.definition: knife skills 指烹饪中切配食材的刀法能力，常用复数形式，如 good knife skills。搭配动词 have、improve、practice；不可数语境也可说 knife work。

examples.en: Good knife skills make it easier to dice onions evenly for the stir-fry.
examples.zh: 好的刀工让你更容易把洋葱切成均匀的丁，用来炒菜。

examples.en: The chef's knife skills are so impressive that he can julienne carrots in seconds.
examples.zh: 这位厨师的刀工非常了得，几秒钟就能把胡萝卜切成细丝。

entries.shortAnswer: 「油炸」的英文是 deep-fry，指把食物完全浸入热油中炸熟，与 pan-fry（煎）不同。
entries.definition: deep-fry 指食物浸没在热油中炸，油多温高，成品外酥里嫩；常见搭配 deep-fry chicken wings。

examples.en: To make crispy spring rolls, you need to deep-fry them until golden brown.
examples.zh: 要做酥脆的春卷，你需要把它们油炸至金黄。

examples.en: She deep-fried the chicken wings for five minutes, then drained them on paper towels.
examples.zh: 她把鸡翅油炸了五分钟，然后放在厨房纸上沥油。

entries.shortAnswer: deep-fry means 油炸: to cook food by fully immersing it in hot oil, unlike pan-fry or stir-fry.
entries.definition: deep-fry is to cook food submerged in hot oil until golden and crisp; common with chicken, shrimp, dough sticks.

examples.en: To make crispy spring rolls, you need to deep-fry them until golden brown.
examples.zh: 要做酥脆的春卷，你需要把它们油炸至金黄。

examples.en: She deep-fried the chicken wings for five minutes, then drained them on paper towels.
examples.zh: 她把鸡翅油炸了五分钟，然后放在厨房纸上沥油。

entries.shortAnswer: 「切片」的英文是 slice，作动词表示把食材切成薄片。关键是：切片（slice）指切成片状，切丝是 julienne，切丁是 dice，别混用。
entries.definition: slice 可作动词和名词：slice the meat（把肉切片）、cut it into thin slices（切成薄片）。刀工词辨析：切片 slice、切丝 julienne、切丁 dice、剁馅 mince。片要均匀，受热才一致。

examples.en: Slice the beef thinly against the grain so it stays tender in the stir-fry.
examples.zh: 把牛肉逆着纹理切薄片，这样炒出来才嫩。

examples.en: Add a slice of ginger and a slice of scallion to the hot oil before tossing in the vegetables.
examples.zh: 热油里先放一片姜和一片葱，再下蔬菜翻炒。

entries.shortAnswer: 「slice」的中文意思是「切片」，指把食材切成薄片，也可指切好的一片。与 chop（剁块）、dice（切丁）不同，slice 强调薄而均匀的片状。
entries.definition: slice 作动词是「把…切片」，作名词是「一片」，如 a slice of bread。烹饪中常说 slice the meat thinly，指逆纹切薄片；与 julienne（切丝）、dice（切丁）、mince（剁碎）分工明确。

examples.en: Slice the beef thinly against the grain so it stays tender in the stir-fry.
examples.zh: 把牛肉逆着纹理切薄片，这样炒出来才嫩。

examples.en: Add a slice of ginger and a slice of scallion to the hot oil before tossing in the vegetables.
examples.zh: 热油里先放一片姜和一片葱，再下蔬菜翻炒。

entries.shortAnswer: 「收汁」的英文是 reduce the sauce，指开盖用中大火把汤汁煮到浓缩变稠。注意它与勾芡 thicken the sauce 不同，收汁靠蒸发，不靠加淀粉。
entries.definition: reduce 在烹饪语境里专指通过加热蒸发水分使液体变浓，宾语常是 sauce、wine、stock、juices。收汁通常在食材熟后开盖进行，火别太大以免糊底；西餐也常说 reduce the sauce by half（收汁收掉一半）。

examples.en: Let the chicken simmer for ten minutes, then uncover the pan and reduce the sauce until it coats the back of a spoon.
examples.zh: 让鸡肉炖十分钟，然后开盖收汁，直到汤汁能挂在勺背上。

examples.en: If the sauce looks too thin, just reduce the sauce over medium-high heat for a few more minutes.
examples.zh: 如果汤汁看起来太稀，就用中大火再多收汁几分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: Reduce the sauce means「收汁」，即开盖加热让汤汁蒸发变浓。它与 thicken the sauce 不同，前者靠蒸发，后者靠加淀粉或勾芡。
entries.definition: reduce the sauce 是西餐厨房常用指令，指用中大火把酱汁或高汤煮到量减少、味道更浓。常见搭配 reduce by half、reduce until thickened；口语里也可只说 reduce。注意不是把火关小，而是要保持沸腾收水。

examples.en: Let the chicken simmer for ten minutes, then uncover the pan and reduce the sauce until it coats the back of a spoon.
examples.zh: 让鸡肉炖十分钟，然后开盖收汁，直到汤汁能挂在勺背上。

examples.en: If the sauce looks too thin, just reduce the sauce over medium-high heat for a few more minutes.
examples.zh: 如果汤汁看起来太稀，就用中大火再多收汁几分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: 「出锅」的英文是 take off the heat，指把锅从火上移开，强调离火动作而非关火。
entries.definition: 常用于炒菜收尾：把锅移离火源，再淋香油或拌入香菜。与关火不同，出锅只是移开锅具，火仍可能燃着。

examples.en: Take the wok off the heat as soon as the sauce thickens, then toss in the scallions.
examples.zh: 酱汁一收浓就出锅，然后拌入葱花。

examples.en: Once the chicken is cooked through, take it off the heat and let it rest for a minute.
examples.zh: 鸡肉熟透后出锅，静置一分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: Take off the heat means 出锅 in Chinese: remove the pan from the burner, not turn off the flame.
entries.definition: A cooking instruction to move a pan or pot off the heat source, often at the end of stir-frying before adding seasoning.

examples.en: Take the wok off the heat as soon as the sauce thickens, then toss in the scallions.
examples.zh: 酱汁一收浓就出锅，然后拌入葱花。

examples.en: Once the chicken is cooked through, take it off the heat and let it rest for a minute.
examples.zh: 鸡肉熟透后出锅，静置一分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: 「切丁」的英文是 dice，指把食材切成大小均匀的小方块，如 diced carrots，区别于切片和切丝。
entries.definition: dice 作动词常搭配食材：dice the onion、diced tomatoes，也可说 cut sth into dice。名词 dice 本义是骰子，所以切出的块要方正均匀。

examples.en: Dice the carrots and potatoes into even cubes before adding them to the stew.
examples.zh: 把胡萝卜和土豆切成大小均匀的丁，再放进炖菜里。

examples.en: The recipe says to dice the onion finely so it blends into the sauce.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱要求把洋葱切成细丁，好让它融入酱汁中。

entries.shortAnswer: dice 的中文意思是「切丁」，即把食物切成均匀小方块，如 dice the carrots 就是「把胡萝卜切丁」。
entries.definition: dice 作动词用于烹饪，常见搭配 dice an onion、diced potatoes，名词形式指骰子状小块，强调方正均匀。

examples.en: Dice the carrots and potatoes into even cubes before adding them to the stew.
examples.zh: 把胡萝卜和土豆切成大小均匀的丁，再放进炖菜里。

examples.en: The recipe says to dice the onion finely so it blends into the sauce.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱要求把洋葱切成细丁，好让它融入酱汁中。

entries.shortAnswer: 切丝的英文是 julienne，指把蔬菜、肉类等切成细长均匀的丝，不是 cut silk。
entries.definition: julienne 指切成细长如火柴杆的丝状刀工，常用于胡萝卜、黄瓜、姜、鸡肉等，可作动词或名词。

examples.en: First julienne the carrots and cucumber, then toss them with a light sesame dressing.
examples.zh: 先把胡萝卜和黄瓜切丝，再用清淡的芝麻酱汁拌匀。

examples.en: The recipe says to julienne the ginger finely so it blends into the stir-fry.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求把姜切细丝，这样能更好地融入炒菜中。

entries.shortAnswer: Julienne means 切丝: cutting food into thin, matchstick-like strips, unlike dice or slice.
entries.definition: As a verb or noun, julienne means cutting vegetables or meat into long thin strips, common in recipes.

examples.en: First julienne the carrots and cucumber, then toss them with a light sesame dressing.
examples.zh: 先把胡萝卜和黄瓜切丝，再用清淡的芝麻酱汁拌匀。

examples.en: The recipe says to julienne the ginger finely so it blends into the stir-fry.
examples.zh: 菜谱要求把姜切细丝，这样能更好地融入炒菜中。

entries.shortAnswer: 剁馅的英文是 mince for filling，指把肉或菜剁碎，用来做饺子、包子等的馅料。
entries.definition: mince for filling 是动词短语，强调把肉或菜剁碎成馅，区别于切丁、切片、切丝。

examples.en: First mince the pork for filling, then mix it with chopped cabbage and ginger.
examples.zh: 先把猪肉剁馅，然后和切碎的白菜、姜末拌在一起。

examples.en: She spent ten minutes mincing mushrooms for filling before wrapping the dumplings.
examples.zh: 她花了十分钟把蘑菇剁馅，然后才开始包饺子。

entries.shortAnswer: Mince for filling means 剁馅: chopping meat or vegetables finely to make dumpling or bun filling.
entries.definition: Mince for filling means cutting meat or vegetables into very fine pieces to make a filling, as for dumplings or buns.

examples.en: First mince the pork for filling, then mix it with chopped cabbage and ginger.
examples.zh: 先把猪肉剁馅，然后和切碎的白菜、姜末拌在一起。

examples.en: She spent ten minutes mincing mushrooms for filling before wrapping the dumplings.
examples.zh: 她花了十分钟把蘑菇剁馅，然后才开始包饺子。

entries.shortAnswer: 生抽的英文是 light soy sauce，一种颜色浅、咸鲜的酱油，主要用来调味提鲜。它与上色用的老抽 dark soy sauce 分工不同，别混用。
entries.definition: 生抽是酿造酱油中颜色较浅、盐分较高的一类，味道咸鲜，常用于炒菜、凉拌、蘸料和腌肉时调味。它主要给菜增加咸味和鲜味，几乎不上色；需要红烧上色时应改用老抽 dark soy sauce。西式厨房若买不到，可用普通 soy sauce 代替，但咸度需自行调整。

examples.en: Add a splash of light soy sauce at the end to season the stir-fry without darkening the vegetables.
examples.zh: 出锅前淋一点生抽给这道炒菜调味，又不会把蔬菜染深。

examples.en: For the dipping sauce, mix light soy sauce with a little vinegar, sugar, and minced garlic.
examples.zh: 做蘸料时，把生抽和少许醋、糖、蒜末调在一起。

entries.shortAnswer: Light soy sauce 的中文意思是生抽，一种颜色浅、咸鲜的酱油，用于调味提鲜。它和上色用的老抽 dark soy sauce 是两种不同的酱油，不能互换。
entries.definition: Light soy sauce 指颜色较浅、咸味和鲜味突出的酿造酱油，是中式烹饪中最常用的调味酱油，适合炒菜、凉拌、蘸食和腌肉。它几乎不给菜上色，因此与浓稠、上色的 dark soy sauce（老抽）用途不同；食谱中若强调上色，应换用后者。

examples.en: Add a splash of light soy sauce at the end to season the stir-fry without darkening the vegetables.
examples.zh: 出锅前淋一点生抽给这道炒菜调味，又不会把蔬菜染深。

examples.en: For the dipping sauce, mix light soy sauce with a little vinegar, sugar, and minced garlic.
examples.zh: 做蘸料时，把生抽和少许醋、糖、蒜末调在一起。

entries.shortAnswer: 老抽的英文是 dark soy sauce，和生抽 light soy sauce 成对使用。它颜色深、质地稠、咸度低，主要用于上色，比如红烧肉或卤味。
entries.definition: 老抽是中式酱油的一种，常在烹饪中与生抽分工：生抽提鲜，老抽上色。常见搭配有“加一点老抽上色”“老抽用于红烧”。注意老抽不是 dark soy 或 black soy sauce，标准说法是 dark soy sauce。

examples.en: To give the braised pork a deep red color, add a tablespoon of dark soy sauce after the sugar melts.
examples.zh: 为了给红烧肉上深红色，在糖融化后加一汤匙老抽。

examples.en: Dark soy sauce is mainly for color, so use it sparingly along with light soy sauce for flavor.
examples.zh: 老抽主要用于上色，所以少量使用，并与生抽一起提鲜。

entries.shortAnswer: Dark soy sauce 的中文意思是“老抽”，一种颜色深、质地略稠、咸度较低的中式酱油。它主要用于给菜肴上色，比如红烧肉或卤味，而生抽 light soy sauce 则用于提鲜。
entries.definition: Dark soy sauce 是中式烹饪中用于上色的酱油，常与 light soy sauce（生抽）搭配。它颜色深、带焦糖色，咸度较低，适合红烧、卤制或炒面。注意不要与“black soy sauce”混淆，后者通常指更浓稠的东南亚黑酱油。

examples.en: To give the braised pork a deep red color, add a tablespoon of dark soy sauce after the sugar melts.
examples.zh: 为了给红烧肉上深红色，在糖融化后加一汤匙老抽。

examples.en: Dark soy sauce is mainly for color, so use it sparingly along with light soy sauce for flavor.
examples.zh: 老抽主要用于上色，所以少量使用，并与生抽一起提鲜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「高汤」的英文是 stock，指用骨头、鸡架等长时间慢煨出的基础汤底，通常不加盐、用于再调味。注意别直接说 soup，soup 是成品汤，stock 是半成品原料。
entries.definition: 中餐吊汤讲等级：毛汤最粗、高汤居中、顶汤（上汤）最清最鲜，口诀「厨子的汤，唱戏的腔」。英文里 stock 偏无盐基础汤，broth 偏可直接喝的汤，做菜常写 chicken stock 或 vegetable stock。

examples.en: Let the chicken stock simmer for two hours, then skim off the fat before using it.
examples.zh: 让鸡高汤小火煨两个小时，用之前把浮油撇掉。

examples.en: If the sauce tastes too thin, reduce it with a splash of beef stock instead of adding more salt.
examples.zh: 如果酱汁太稀，别再加盐，改加一点牛肉高汤收浓。

entries.shortAnswer: stock 的中文意思是「高汤」，指用骨头或鸡架慢火熬出的基础汤底，多不加盐，作原料而非直接饮用。和 broth 的区别是：broth 通常已调味、可直接喝，stock 更浓、胶质多。
entries.definition: stock 是烹饪核心词，常见搭配 chicken stock、beef stock、vegetable stock、homemade stock。既用于家常菜谱，也用于正式烹饪语境。易错点：不要把 stock 说成 soup，soup 是成品菜，stock 只是底料。

examples.en: Let the chicken stock simmer for two hours, then skim off the fat before using it.
examples.zh: 让鸡高汤小火煨两个小时，用之前把浮油撇掉。

examples.en: If the sauce tastes too thin, reduce it with a splash of beef stock instead of adding more salt.
examples.zh: 如果酱汁太稀，别再加盐，改加一点牛肉高汤收浓。

entries.shortAnswer: 「料酒」的英文是 cooking wine，指中式烹饪用的调味黄酒，不是喝的酒。
entries.definition: 料酒是中式去腥增香的调味酒，常用于腌肉、焯水、炝锅和炖煮。英文常说 add a splash of cooking wine，不要写成 wine 或 rice wine。

examples.en: Blanch the pork ribs with a splash of cooking wine to remove the smell.
examples.zh: 焯排骨时加一点料酒去腥。

examples.en: Marinate the fish in cooking wine and ginger for ten minutes before steaming.
examples.zh: 蒸鱼前用料酒和姜腌十分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: cooking wine 的中文是「料酒」，指中餐里去腥增香的调味黄酒，不是普通佐餐酒。
entries.definition: cooking wine 是中式烹调常用的调味酒，常与生抽、姜、葱同用。搭配如 add cooking wine、marinate in cooking wine、blanch with cooking wine。

examples.en: Blanch the pork ribs with a splash of cooking wine to remove the smell.
examples.zh: 焯排骨时加一点料酒去腥。

examples.en: Marinate the fish in cooking wine and ginger for ten minutes before steaming.
examples.zh: 蒸鱼前用料酒和姜腌十分钟。

entries.shortAnswer: 「调料」的英文是 seasonings，通常用复数形式，泛指烹饪时用来增添风味的各种调味材料。
entries.definition: 调料在英文中常说 seasonings，复数形式泛指盐、胡椒、酱油、香草等用于烹饪调味的材料，也可单数 seasoning 指一种调料。

examples.en: Add the seasonings after the vegetables are half-cooked so they keep their fresh flavor.
examples.zh: 蔬菜炒到半熟时再加调料，这样能保持它们的新鲜风味。

examples.en: This dish uses simple seasonings like soy sauce, garlic, and a pinch of sugar.
examples.zh: 这道菜用了简单的调料，比如酱油、大蒜和一小撮糖。

entries.shortAnswer: Seasonings 的中文是「调料」，指烹饪时用来增添风味的各种材料，常用复数形式。
entries.definition: Seasonings 是复数名词，指盐、胡椒、酱油、香草等调味材料的总称，单数形式 seasoning 可指其中一种调料。

examples.en: Add the seasonings after the vegetables are half-cooked so they keep their fresh flavor.
examples.zh: 蔬菜炒到半熟时再加调料，这样能保持它们的新鲜风味。

examples.en: This dish uses simple seasonings like soy sauce, garlic, and a pinch of sugar.
examples.zh: 这道菜用了简单的调料，比如酱油、大蒜和一小撮糖。

entries.shortAnswer: 「和面」的英文是 knead dough，指用手反复揉压面粉与水混合成的面团，使其光滑有弹性。
entries.definition: knead dough 指用手掌反复推压、折叠面团，使其出筋、光滑，是做面包、饺子皮的关键步骤。搭配：knead the dough until smooth。只把面粉和水搅成团，多说 mix the dough。

examples.en: Knead the dough until it is smooth and no longer sticky, then cover it and let it rest.
examples.zh: 把面团揉到光滑不粘手，然后盖上让它醒一会儿。

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to knead dough by hand when we made dumplings together.
examples.zh: 我们一起包饺子时，奶奶教我怎么用手和面。

entries.shortAnswer: knead dough 的中文意思是「和面」，即用手反复揉压面粉与水混合成的面团，使其均匀上劲。
entries.definition: knead dough 指用手掌反复推压、折叠面团，使其光滑有弹性，常见于做面包、饺子。搭配：knead the dough until smooth、knead it for ten minutes。别与 mix（拌匀）混用。

examples.en: Knead the dough until it is smooth and no longer sticky, then cover it and let it rest.
examples.zh: 把面团揉到光滑不粘手，然后盖上让它醒一会儿。

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to knead dough by hand when we made dumplings together.
examples.zh: 我们一起包饺子时，奶奶教我怎么用手和面。

entries.shortAnswer: 「醒面」的英文是 let the dough rest，指和好面后静置，让面筋松弛、水分均匀，面团更好擀开。
entries.definition: 醒面指和面后盖住静置，使面筋松弛、水分吃透，面团更柔软易擀。英文常说 let the dough rest，别与 rise、proof 混用。

examples.en: After kneading, cover the bowl and let the dough rest for about twenty minutes before rolling it out.
examples.zh: 揉好面后盖上碗，让面团醒大约二十分钟再擀开。

examples.en: The recipe says to let the dough rest so the gluten relaxes and the wrappers are easier to shape.
examples.zh: 这个菜谱要求醒面，好让面筋松弛，饺子皮更容易擀。

entries.shortAnswer: let the dough rest 的中文意思是「醒面」，即和好面后静置，让面筋松弛、水分均匀，它与 rise、proof 不同。
entries.definition: let the dough rest 指和面后盖上静置，使面筋松弛、面团更易擀开。也可说 let it rest；注意区别于 rise 和 proof。

examples.en: After kneading, cover the bowl and let the dough rest for about twenty minutes before rolling it out.
examples.zh: 揉好面后盖上碗，让面团醒大约二十分钟再擀开。

examples.en: The recipe says to let the dough rest so the gluten relaxes and the wrappers are easier to shape.
examples.zh: 这个菜谱要求醒面，好让面筋松弛，饺子皮更容易擀。

entries.shortAnswer: 「擀面」的英文是 roll out dough，指用擀面杖把面团擀成薄片，强调擀开擀薄，不是揉面。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：roll out the dough 或 roll the dough out。工具是 rolling pin（擀面杖），常在撒粉案板上操作防粘。与 knead（揉面）不同：knead 揉出筋度，roll out 把面团擀成饺子皮、派皮等薄片。

examples.en: Lightly flour the counter, then roll out dough until it's about three millimeters thick.
examples.zh: 在台面上撒少许面粉，然后把面团擀到大约三毫米厚。

examples.en: If the dough sticks while you're rolling it out, dust it with a little more flour.
examples.zh: 擀面时如果面团粘住，就再撒一点面粉。

entries.shortAnswer: roll out dough 的中文意思是「擀面」，即用擀面杖把面团擀成薄片，强调压开擀薄，而非揉面。
entries.definition: roll out dough 是烹饪常用短语，工具为 rolling pin（擀面杖），常在撒粉案板上操作以防粘。注意区分 knead（揉面）与 roll out（擀开擀薄），做饺子皮、派皮时常用。

examples.en: Lightly flour the counter, then roll out dough until it's about three millimeters thick.
examples.zh: 在台面上撒少许面粉，然后把面团擀到大约三毫米厚。

examples.en: If the dough sticks while you're rolling it out, dust it with a little more flour.
examples.zh: 擀面时如果面团粘住，就再撒一点面粉。

entries.shortAnswer: 「发酵」在烘焙中常说 let it rise，指让面团膨胀变松软，不用于酿酒或做酱。
entries.definition: let it rise 常见于烘焙，表示让揉好的面团静置发酵膨胀，如 let the dough rise。酿酒制酱多用 ferment。

examples.en: After kneading the dough, cover it and let it rise in a warm place for about an hour.
examples.zh: 揉好面团后，盖上盖子，放在温暖处让它发酵约一小时。

examples.en: If the kitchen is cold, let it rise in the oven with just the light on.
examples.zh: 如果厨房太冷，就只开烤箱的灯，把面团放进去发酵。

entries.shortAnswer: Let it rise means 发酵 in baking: leave dough to swell and soften, not for wine or sauce.
entries.definition: In baking, let it rise means to leave dough in a warm place until it swells and doubles, as in let the dough rise.

examples.en: After kneading the dough, cover it and let it rise in a warm place for about an hour.
examples.zh: 揉好面团后，盖上盖子，放在温暖处让它发酵约一小时。

examples.en: If the kitchen is cold, let it rise in the oven with just the light on.
examples.zh: 如果厨房太冷，就只开烤箱的灯，把面团放进去发酵。

entries.shortAnswer: 「小火慢炖」的英文是 simmer on low heat，指保持微沸状态长时间加热。
entries.definition: simmer on low heat 指用小火让汤汁保持微沸，常用于炖汤、收汁、熬酱，可搭配 for + 时间。

examples.en: Let the broth simmer on low heat for at least an hour to develop a deeper flavor.
examples.zh: 让高汤小火慢炖至少一个小时，味道会更浓郁。

examples.en: After bringing the sauce to a boil, turn down the heat and let it simmer on low heat until it thickens.
examples.zh: 酱汁煮沸后转小火，慢慢炖至浓稠。

entries.shortAnswer: Simmer on low heat means 小火慢炖 in Chinese: cook just below boiling.
entries.definition: To simmer on low heat is to cook gently in liquid just below boiling, with tiny bubbles rising. Common in soups, sauces, and braises.

examples.en: Let the broth simmer on low heat for at least an hour to develop a deeper flavor.
examples.zh: 让高汤小火慢炖至少一个小时，味道会更浓郁。

examples.en: After bringing the sauce to a boil, turn down the heat and let it simmer on low heat until it thickens.
examples.zh: 酱汁煮沸后转小火，慢慢炖至浓稠。
